---
|
---

**CAMPAIGN KICKOFF July 9th!** **Plan to attend Calvary Chapel San Jose services on Sunday, July 9th** , as Peter will be speaking to the congregation about how God is leading him to run again in 2024. Hear about other campaign updates and sign up to volunteer! We have plenty to do ALREADY for the upcoming primary and general in 2024....so come and get fired up!
[**CALVARY CHAPEL SAN JOSE WEBSITE**](https://hernandezforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=314f047675baff18221b82bdc&id=cd323865b3&e=638e6c2751)
| |
**"Need Volunteers?" you ask...
Why, Yes, We Do!**
Our campaign volunteers last election cycle humbled me to my core. The enthusiasm, the goodwill, the time given to help get my name and message out to CD18 was beyond amazing. I can't thank my volunteer team enough.

We have learned a lot, and the volunteer activities for the upcoming primary and general election 2024 will be focused in some new and exciting ways. **OUR VOLUNTEER KICK-OFF WILL BE SUNDAY, JULY 9TH, WHEN I SPEAK AT CALVARY CHAPEL SAN JOSE.** We invite you to attend Calvary services on July 9th to hear more about volunteer opportunities with the campaign. You can also [**email my campaign manager, Kristin Hurley**](mailto:kristin@hernandezforcongress.com?subject=Yes!%20I'll%20volunteer%20for%20Peter%20Hernandez%20for%20Congress%202024!), to let her know you'd like to help and she'll keep you in the loop. We plan an all-volunteer meeting for shortly after July 9th to outline our goals, so please stay tuned for information about that.

name: American Update
subject: Former Home Depot CEO issues dire warning for Americans
body:
Something strange is happening in our financial system.

| Dear Reader, Something strange is happening in our financial system. According to analysts at UBS, more than 50,000 retail locations could shut their doors in the months ahead. Already, Walmart, Foot Locker, Bed Bath & Beyond, and Macy’s are cutting stores. And former Home Depot CEO Bob Nardelli recently issued a grim warning:
> “We’re going to see a lot of bankruptcies. [This is] different than anything I have seen in my 52 years...”
What does it all mean for your family and your money? Dr. Nomi Prins has dug deeper into the research, and she’s found something startling. Amid all the turmoil predicted by Nardeni and UBS, Prins has found a single firm that could be the canary in the coal mine foreshadowing the next major crisis in America. All it takes is one look at this troubling chart to see why - [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c660103%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2bPVWN7k8CWZazeu97SqHbQ&sysid=1) Dr. Prins says:
> ** “This chart tells you everything you need to know about the next crisis in America. In short, what we’re about to see is a currency crisis - but not the kind of currency crisis most folks expect. This firm - along with many others - will almost certainly go bankrupt as a result.” **
According to Dr. Prins, our money is about to change forever... and the overhaul is set to happen in just a few weeks. To help folks prepare, she’s recorded a briefing that explains all the details of what she calls a ‘reset’ to our financial system. In it, she lays out all the evidence of this currency crisis, and what you can do to prepare. [Click here now to see her full (and free) presentation.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c660104%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=dMKvoKHbOZtAhmqXfCrHLw&sysid=1) Regards, Maria Bonaventura
Senior Managing Editor, Rogue Economics **P.S.** The last time we saw a similar transformations to our money, folks who failed to prepare were blindsided. But those who moved their money beforehand had the opportunity to multiply their nest-egg as a result. [Click here to see why.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c660115%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=0e26OdZ0Ca5BhMIwBNdacw&sysid=1)

clean_body: Something strange is happening in our financial system. | Dear Reader, Something strange is happening in our financial system. According to analysts at UBS, more than 50,000 retail locations could shut their doors in the months ahead. Already, Walmart, Foot Locker, Bed Bath & Beyond, and Macy’s are cutting stores. And former Home Depot CEO Bob Nardelli recently issued a grim warning: “We’re going to see a lot of bankruptcies. [This is] different than anything I have seen in my 52 years...” What does it all mean for your family and your money? Dr. Nomi Prins has dug deeper into the research, and she’s found something startling. Amid all the turmoil predicted by Nardeni and UBS, Prins has found a single firm that could be the canary in the coal mine foreshadowing the next major crisis in America. All it takes is one look at this troubling chart to see why - Dr. Prins says: “This chart tells you everything you need to know about the next crisis in America. In short, what we’re about to see is a currency crisis - but not the kind of currency crisis most folks expect. This firm - along with many others - will almost certainly go bankrupt as a result.” According to Dr. Prins, our money is about to change forever... and the overhaul is set to happen in just a few weeks. To help folks prepare, she’s recorded a briefing that explains all the details of what she calls a ‘reset’ to our financial system. In it, she lays out all the evidence of this currency crisis, and what you can do to prepare. Regards, Maria Bonaventura Senior Managing Editor, Rogue Economics P.S. The last time we saw a similar transformations to our money, folks who failed to prepare were blindsided. But those who moved their money beforehand had the opportunity to multiply their nest-egg as a result. American Update 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314 |

subject: The Rare Phenomenon of Citizenship
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWXF3MBDNd

I invite you to view an eight-lecture course that we prepared....

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWXF3MBDNd

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
friend,
I invite
you to view an eight-lecture course that we prepared. It is
called "American Citizenship and Its Decline," and the online
course is based on Victor Davis Hanson's book, The Dying Citizen.

Like the
book, the course describes the current crises in America as
symptoms of a far larger problem: the steady decline of the
autonomy and political influence of the citizen.

The class
describes the origins and history of citizenship in the West,
reminding us that it is a rare phenomenon both in the past and
the present-given the enormous responsibility placed on citizens
to create and control their own government.

Citizenship then requires a large and self-reliant middle
class-currently shrinking under enormous economic strains.
Clearly defined and enforced borders are also essential to ensure
a civic space in which citizens can nurture common customs,
sustain traditions, and honor their own shared past.

Yet
borders are now increasingly fluid as mere residence and
citizenship seem often indistinguishable. Pre-civilizational
tribalism-identifying by superficial appearance rather than
through shared culture and values-is returning to America as so
often the salad bowl replaces the melting pot.

These
organic, bottom-up challenges are often matched by top-down
stresses such as the growth of a huge, permanent, but unelected,
government of bureaucrats and administrators who combine
judicial, executive, and legislative powers that overwhelm the
citizen.

In
addition, revisionists in law, the media, and politics seek to
change the Constitution, long-held customs of governance, and
political traditions for short-term partisan agendas, on the
theory that a new, changing, and fluid Constitution must match an
always evolving human nature.

Globalism
is an ancient challenge to the sovereignty of the nation-state.
But in the age of instant communications and unprecedented
concentrations of globalized wealth, so often elites seek to
supplant American laws and independence with international
organizations and often without the consent of the legislative
branch or the assent of the governed.

The
course ends, however, on an optimistic note that citizens still
have it within their power to restore our traditions of empowered
citizenship and return government to the control of citizens.

You can
receive a DVD box set of "American Citizenship and Its Decline"
with a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more toward Hillsdale
College's Annual Fund. You can easily give and reserve your DVD
box set using this secure link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61971282:WXF3MBDNd:m:3:2532013465:074F110DB34D28D8C350A4EE64350B22:r

Best
wishes,

Kyle

clean_body: I invite you to view an eight-lecture course that we prepared.... Please see a special message from our sponsor: Dear friend, I invite you to view an eight-lecture course that we prepared. It is called "American Citizenship and Its Decline," and the online course is based on Victor Davis Hanson's book, The Dying Citizen. Like the book, the course describes the current crises in America as symptoms of a far larger problem: the steady decline of the autonomy and political influence of the citizen. The class describes the origins and history of citizenship in the West, reminding us that it is a rare phenomenon both in the past and the present-given the enormous responsibility placed on citizens to create and control their own government. Citizenship then requires a large and self-reliant middle class-currently shrinking under enormous economic strains. Clearly defined and enforced borders are also essential to ensure a civic space in which citizens can nurture common customs, sustain traditions, and honor their own shared past. Yet borders are now increasingly fluid as mere residence and citizenship seem often indistinguishable. Pre-civilizational tribalism-identifying by superficial appearance rather than through shared culture and values-is returning to America as so often the salad bowl replaces the melting pot. These organic, bottom-up challenges are often matched by top-down stresses such as the growth of a huge, permanent, but unelected, government of bureaucrats and administrators who combine judicial, executive, and legislative powers that overwhelm the citizen. In addition, revisionists in law, the media, and politics seek to change the Constitution, long-held customs of governance, and political traditions for short-term partisan agendas, on the theory that a new, changing, and fluid Constitution must match an always evolving human nature. Globalism is an ancient challenge to the sovereignty of the nation-state. But in the age of instant communications and unprecedented concentrations of globalized wealth, so often elites seek to supplant American laws and independence with international organizations and often without the consent of the legislative branch or the assent of the governed. The course ends, however, on an optimistic note that citizens still have it within their power to restore our traditions of empowered citizenship and return government to the control of citizens. You can receive a DVD box set of "American Citizenship and Its Decline" with a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more toward Hillsdale College's Annual Fund. #
[**Friend — I am reaching out today to respectfully ask you to make a $3 contribution to The Long Run before our FEC fundraising deadline at midnight tonight.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-jun23.F10pcU&refcode=em230630-1-tt&t=1&akid=4606%2E196590%2EcptlaN)
Earlier this week, my team and I reached out to you about our $15,000 fundraising goal and how we cannot afford to come up short. Why? Because when we close the books on our first FEC deadline of the year, we are required by law to publicly report our fundraising numbers. This is our FIRST chance to publicly report our progress and the strength and vigor this movement has behind it.
This goal was a steep one — one I wasn’t sure we could reach when my team told me the number. But this team has defied the odds before and will continue to reach new heights as long as we stand together. And you all did just that.
It started with Ronald from Chicago giving $10. Then Vanessa from Houston pitched in her $50. And Sally from Shorewood added her $100 too. And now they are counting on you to join them.
[**Can you please make a $3 contribution to our movement ahead of our first FEC fundraising deadline? We cannot reach our goals without your support.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-jun23.F10pcU&refcode=em230630-1-tt&t=2&akid=4606%2E196590%2EcptlaN)
So far, this team has already made a substantial impact in races across the country — from supporting trailblazing candidates like including Judge Janet in Wisconsin and Lashrecese Aird in Virginia to supporting candidates that will expand our Senate Majority like Colin Allred in Texas and Ruben Gallego in Arizona.
But the stakes in 2024 are high, and these campaigns will need much more funding and support than ever before.
And that’s where we come in. Because if we have your support, we can help strengthen change-making candidates from the get-go, so they have the funding to invest in the backbone of their campaign — whether that be organizing efforts, TV ads, GOTV, or rallies. And the more funding they have, the more voters they can engage.
So our work is critical to the success of many campaigns and we cannot leave any stone unturned.
Before we reach our first FEC deadline at midnight tonight, I am asking once more:
[**Can you please make a $3 contribution to The Long Run today? We will not be able to reach our fundraising goal without you by our side.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-jun23.F10pcU&refcode=em230630-1-tt&t=6&akid=4606%2E196590%2EcptlaN)
Your support today will be critical to the success of our PAC and many other campaigns in the coming cycle, so I hope you will join me today.
With gratitude,
Mandela Barnes

Team Daniels for Congress here!
We are working hard to set up Shamaine’s campaign and wanted to follow up on her email about today's important fundraising deadline and ask for your support. Can you make a contribution before the June 30 th fundraising deadline? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]

At this rate, our orcas can’t hold on much longer. As a grassroots organization, we can’t fight the hard battles ahead for our orcas, our oceans and our planet without you, friend. == If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | == | | == | | == | | == We wouldn’t ask if it wasn’t urgent, but orcas are facing a DIRE survival crisis. That’s the reason we had to set such an ambitious goal before our End-of-Fiscal-Year deadline. Because as you read this, Southern Resident orcas are grieving beloved family members who have already died from starvation. Every death weakens the entire orca pod, making them more vulnerable to pollution from the cruise industry and Big Oil.Unless we act, industrial mega-projects and massive quantities of cruise ship waste could spell DISASTER for our orcas and completely wipe them from the face of the planet. More profits for wealthy corporations aren’t worth the extinction of a unique and precious species. Friends of the Earth has one goal: to STOP disastrous outcomes for our planet and its vulnerable inhabitants. That means preventing existing dangers from getting any worse and holding greedy corporations accountable for the damage they’ve caused. As part of the world’s largest grassroots environmental network, we’re committed to continuing this fight. But we can’t raise what it takes to win for orcas and our planet without your membership gift – and there’s only 11 hours left before our End-of-Fiscal-Year deadline. Please, with time running out and the stakes for our planet higher than ever, we’re counting on your support before the clock strikes midnight. == If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | == | | == | | == | | == Regards, Marcie Keever Director of Oceans & Vessels Program Friends of the Earth | Contact Us: Friends of the Earth U.S. Washington, D.C. | Berkeley, CA 1-877-843-8687

body:
Building what we have is not something that can happen overnight, and it's certainly not something I can do alone.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=310%2E791427%2ELFZt99)

Friends -
I'm writing this morning to respectfully ask for **[your $3 contribution to our campaign before tonight's FEC fundraising deadline.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-june23.qnOuuh&refcode=em230630-1-t1r&t=2&akid=310%2E791427%2ELFZt99)** Let me explain why this request is so important, especially today.
Here's the truth:
Being a member of Congress, going to work representing my community and fighting for working people every day is truly one of the joys of my life. It's a privilege and an honor, and one I have never once taken for granted.
But if I had to pick the worst part about this job, I would quickly tell you it is — by far — the obscene amount of money it requires to run successful campaigns.
It's a part of the reason so many of my colleagues in Washington are happy to take checks from corporate PACs. Or Wall Street billionaires. Or massive, polluting fossil fuel companies.
It's easy.
When I first ran for Congress in 2018, I knew that's not how I would do things. And I'm one of only a small number of people in Washington who will proudly be able to tell you that.
I'm extremely fortunate — every hour I don't have to spend dialing for dollars or asking the wealthy and powerful for campaign contributions is another I get to spend fighting for policies that help working people, supporting my constituents, or being with my family.
But ever since I began organizing in my community in Minnesota, I've known that building what we have is not something that can happen overnight, and it's certainly not something I can do alone.
It takes a grassroots movement, and a tremendous amount of hard work, guts, sweat, and tears to be able to take on millions of dollars in dark money and outside spending over and over again.
And doing what we do — funding our campaigns _together_ , $5, $10, or $50 at a time — means that from time to time I do have to ask. And today is an important one of those days:
**[Can I count on you to make your first contribution — of $3 or anything you can — before tonight's official FEC fundraising deadline ends at midnight? Your support means everything to our campaign, and I wouldn't ask if it weren't so fundamental to our success.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-june23.qnOuuh&refcode=em230630-1-t1r&t=3&akid=310%2E791427%2ELFZt99)**

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection, holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

Derek, I’m sure you’re tired of receiving end-of-quarter fundraising emails, so today I’m sending you a step by step recipe for BBQ Chicken instead. [If you’d like to donate, please click here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65685026/414235035/800907059?refcode=dpva-em-063023&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMDA0YjNlNi01MDE3LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=y4-rspTwviByH2nHCKBBgb7tzswMPyQGdHQzqajkADU=) **Ingredients:** 4 bone in/skin on chicken leg quarters Kosher salt BBQ rub (or make your own!) BBQ sauce (we like Sweet Baby Rays)
1. The night before, liberally sprinkle each chicken piece with kosher salt. Place chicken on a wire rack in a baking tray uncovered in the fridge overnight to dry-brine.
2. 1 hour before grilling, take chicken out. Lightly coat with your favorite BBQ rub. (or make your own with a little garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and brown sugar) But make sure not to use something overly salty as the chicken already has been salted.
3. Fire up grill with two zones for direct and indirect cooking. Feel free to throw a chunk of hickory or apple wood directly on the coals to get a little more smoke flavor.
4. Once the grill stabilizes at around 400°, place chicken skin side up on the indirect side. Cover and let cook for 20 minutes, then flip and cook for another 20 minutes.
5. After chicken has reached an internal temperature of at least 175°, crisp skin by briefly placing skin side down over direct heat.
6. Return chicken to indirect heat, skin side up and brush with your favorite BBQ sauce. Let cook for another 5 or so minutes to set the sauce.
7. Rest for 10 minutes then dig in!

Peter – I’ll keep this short.

Tonight at midnight is our first quarterly fundraising deadline, and shortly after, we’ll be required to make our fundraising numbers public. This is a major milestone for any campaign, but especially for us – as a newly launched campaign in an open Democratic seat. name: Gavin Newsom
subject: As Bobby Kennedy said, “History reminds us that each of us will be judged…”
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CAMPAIGN FOR DEMOCRACY PAC
body:
All across this country, extremist Republicans are systematically attacking the very foundations of our free society.

Friends -
I am writing to ask if you can make your first $3 contribution to my Campaign for Democracy PAC before our first FEC fundraising deadline ends tonight at midnight.
If you know the importance of taking the fight directly to Republicans in this election and are ready to chip-in to help, please use this link:
[**/https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/FEC-Deadline**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cfd-em-june-23?refcode=em230630-1-subs&refcode2=1480_4767699_Cbh_2d&akid=1480%2E4767699%2ECbh_2d)
Otherwise, let me explain:
All across this country, extremist Republicans are systematically attacking the very foundations of our free society.
They've silenced speech, fired teachers, kidnapped migrants, subjugated women and attacked the Special Olympics.
They've made it harder to vote and easier to buy assault weapons.
They've sold fear and panic when it comes to crime, but calm and indifference when the threat is greenhouse gasses destroying our planet.
They've fanned the flames of culture wars to distract from the fact that Blue States have lower murder rates, better health care outcomes and higher GDPs.
My PAC, the Campaign for Democracy, will tell the truth.
We're on the road and on offense — in Red States and places like Sean Hannity's show — to save our democracy and help folks like President Biden at the top of the ticket all the way down the ballot.
We're taking the fight to the gun lobby and working to pass a Constitutional amendment to make our communities safer from gun violence.
We’re doing this because the future is not something to experience, it’s something to manifest.
So I am asking for your help. We all have a responsibility to do something in this moment, no matter our role in life.
[**Can I count on you to contribute $3, or whatever you can afford today, to my Campaign for Democracy PAC? Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

body:
I’m writing this as my kids fight over who is monopolizing the bathroom
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=25725%2E3422442%2EZTCfpo)
Our federal fundraising deadline is tonight at midnight. More below on who I am, why I’m running, and why I need your support below—but if you’re already on Team Porter, [**could you make a donation of $5 today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230630-1?amount=5&refcode=EMAI30_1_EOQ_20230630_V1_F&refcode2=25725_3422442_ZTCfpo&akid=25725%2E3422442%2EZTCfpo)
**[Donate $5 ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230630-1?amount=5&refcode=EMAI30_1_EOQ_20230630_V1_F&refcode2=25725_3422442_ZTCfpo&akid=25725%2E3422442%2EZTCfpo)**
Derek, I’m writing this as my kids fight over who is monopolizing the bathroom—I’m a single mom of three loosely supervised children here in Irvine. Before running for office, I was a law professor and consumer protection attorney who worked to hold Wall Street accountable.
After the election of Trump, I decided to run for Congress against a Republican incumbent. **I ran as a progressive in a purple district** —proudly supporting Medicare for All and bold action on climate change. We won, and I headed to Congress with a tool from my teaching days—a whiteboard (I really do carry one in my purse).
That whiteboard helped me find my voice in Congress. It helped us expose the incompetence of Trump Administration officials. It allowed me to show the math behind corporate greed and skyrocketing profits to hold CEOs accountable. **Those whiteboard moments translated to real wins—passing legislation to lower drug costs, raise rates on polluters, and address inflation.**
In January, I announced I’m running for the U.S. Senate. I’m running because Californians deserve a warrior fighting for them, taking on the challenges of tomorrow. **Big corporations and the politicians they fund have rigged the rules against working people, making it hard to get ahead.** I’m running to stand up to corruption and shake up the status quo.
Polls have shown us with a very narrow lead in this race. **But during the last fundraising quarter, another candidate outraised us by two million dollars thanks to large donations.** Nearly half of voters remain undecided, so catching up financially and being able to reach these undecided voters is critical.
We can only win this race with the support of grassroots donors like you. That’s not just a talking point, it’s true. **Our average donation is $25, and I’m the only candidate in this race rejecting federal lobbyist money.**
Our federal deadline is tonight at midnight, **and the number we report will have real consequences for our campaign.** [**Can you make your first donation of $5 before midnight tonight?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230630-1?amount=5&refcode=EMAI30_1_EOQ_20230630_V1_F&refcode2=25725_3422442_ZTCfpo&akid=25725%2E3422442%2EZTCfpo)
Thank you SO much for considering.
Katie Porter

Katie is running for the U.S. Senate because Californians deserve a warrior fighting for them in Washington. Our campaign is people-powered, we don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or executives from Big Oil or Big Pharma. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-footer?refcode=EMAI30_1_EOQ_20230630_V1_F&t=2&refcode2=25725_3422442_ZTCfpo&akid=25725%2E3422442%2EZTCfpo)**

An "insect apocalypse."
A "second Silent Spring."
A "catastrophic collapse of nature's ecosystems."
This is how scientists are describing the loss of bees and other insects. [**The time to act is now: Donate $27 or more and help us meet our $150,000 Fiscal Year End goal for pollinators and the planet! When you do, your gift will be matched, dollar for dollar, up to our goal -- but only until midnight TONIGHT.**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1855926?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
Neonicotinoid pesticides are a key driver of this crisis. They can impact bees' ability to navigate and reproduce and**even kill bees on contact.** But they're also the most widely used insecticides in agriculture.
The EPA has a chance to ban neonics once and for all. Instead, it might _**approve these pesticides for another 15 years.**_ But there's still hope, Friend. Because of supporters like you, we have the chance to make real change -- change that would help protect bees, people, and the planet. Will you join us in this fight?

Bees play a crucial role in their ecosystems. From fields of blooming wildflowers to rows of veggies on farms, these insects and others aid in plant reproduction. Many of these plants support an entire web of life by offering habitat and food for countless other species.
We rely on bees and other pollinators for 75% of the world's food crops, including the most nutritious -- so when we lose bees, we also lose some of the foods **that keep us healthy!** In fact, the decline in bees and other pollinators has already harmed global fruit, vegetable, and nut production. Without access to these vital crops and a healthy diet, people could be at higher risk of _**heart disease, stroke, diabetes, and even cancer, according to a recent study.**_
There's no mystery here. Study after study has found that the massive use of pesticides, like Bayer-Monsanto's bee-toxic neonicotinoids, is a key driver in the decimation of pollinators.
But pollinator-killers like Bayer-Monsanto are sweeping their lethal impact under the rug -- and the United States EPA is giving them a free pass, allowing widespread use of toxic pesticides instead of shifting away from chemicals we KNOW are killing massive numbers of bees.

body:
I want everyone, from our grassroots network to our opposition, to see the true strength, unity, and longevity of our movement.
#
Hey Peter, it's Pramila!
I wanted to check in personally ahead of tonight's deadline. Over the last week, I’ve seen this movement rise up and show inspirational levels of support for our campaign ahead of our end of quarter deadline.
**Take a look at what we’ve accomplished with your support:**
[****](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/42661?refcode=em20230630-2661&t=1&akid=2661%2E420207%2ECVGbmJ)
Thanks to supporters like you, we’re closing the gap on our end of quarter goal, but we still have $1,750 left to raise before midnight tonight if we want to stay on track with our goals for the next six months. [**Can we count on you to help us reach our goal by making a donation of any amount before the clock strikes midnight tonight?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/42661?refcode=em20230630-2661&t=2&akid=2661%2E420207%2ECVGbmJ)
**[Donate ››](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/42661?refcode=em20230630-2661&t=21&akid=2661%2E420207%2ECVGbmJ)**
I have seen this movement move mountains for the causes and efforts we believe in. We’ve built this campaign from the ground up without any support from wealthy mega donors, special interest groups, or corporations because we know that the real power lies with the people.
Come tomorrow, our quarterly fundraising numbers will be publicized for all to view and make judgement about. And I want everyone, from our grassroots network to our opposition, to see the true strength, unity, and longevity of our movement.
The clock is ticking, and we have less than 12 hours left to go before we close the books on Q2. [**Chip in today to help us close the gap and maintain our fight for progressive change well into the future.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/42661?refcode=em20230630-2661&t=22&akid=2661%2E420207%2ECVGbmJ)

body:
If just 63 people pitch in $8 before midnight, we’ll reach our $15,000 end-of-quarter goal.

Hi Peter, Tara here — I have a packed day so I’ll keep this short.

[**But if just 63 supporters pitch in $8 each before midnight, we’ll reach our goal and end this quarter on a strong note. So can you pitch in $8 or any amount right now to help us get there?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230630?refcode=em20230630&amount=8&refcode2=1177_120351_Yn2n-g&akid=1177%2E120351%2EYn2n-g)

Dear friend,
The Tennessee Voter Project team has its sight set on making Tennessee the Progressive Center of the South. This is our moment to put our hands to the plow.
Today is our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline and we need your support before midnight tonight to make sure we're gassed up for the elections ahead.
We're proud of the work we've done so far. Last year, we supported the efforts to oust Republicans from every Countywide seat in Shelby County. TVP endorsed candidates have led the charge for some of the most progressive initiatives in the South. From championing criminal justice reform to fighting for working families to defending our democracy, we know now more than ever that our vision for a Tennessee that works for all of its residents is within reach.
As we approach the upcoming elections, we know there is more to be done. Your contribution today, no matter the amount, will help us build a war chest to elect folks at the local and state level prepared to lead the South. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tvpaug17_1]
DONATE TO TVP BEFORE MIDNIGHT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tvpaug17_1]
The eyes of the nation are on Tennessee. When we come together, we have the power to shape the future of the South, in spite of all the odds.
Please stand with us in this crucial moment. Consider donating before midnight tonight. Remember every dollar counts. Whether it's $10, $50, or $100, your contribution gets us closer to a Tennessee we can be proud of. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tvpaug17_1]

Hey y’all, it’s Carville. I’m gonna ask for JUST 2 minutes of your time, okay?
Okay — let’s talk about my friend, Bob Casey. That’s right, this guy.

[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230630-2?refcode=em20230630-2&refcode2=225_552475_14PhEE&akid=225%2E552475%2E14PhEE)

Politicians from both parties have written off too much of our state. They’ve stopped showing up in small towns and remote counties – but those Mississippians need someone who will fight for them.

body:

#
Good morning, Derek. Paul Eaton here.
If you’re anything like me, you respect it when people don’t waste your time. So I’ll cut right to the chase:
At midnight tonight, we hit our Q2 FEC deadline. **[And I am personally asking you to make a contribution to VoteVets before then. |

[The Daily Beast](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=719a58091c&e=d0a9afa930)
Matt Lewis
June 29, 2023
“Don’t look now, but Chris Christie is having a moment.
“While Donald Trump is clearly the prohibitive front-runner for the Republican nomination, there is no denying that Christie is the most interesting of the growing Republican field of candidates clamoring for that coveted spot. Consider just a few of Christie’s recent greatest hits.
“When Trump mocked Christie’s weight, Christie, appearing on Fox News’ ‘MediaBuzz,’ responded, ‘Oh what, like he’s some Adonis?’ When asked about Trump diverting campaign money to pay for his legal expenses, Christie called him ‘the cheapest S.O.B. I’ve ever met in my life.’ And regarding the GOP’s performances in 2018, 2020, and 2022, Christie called the former president a ‘three-time loser.’ ...
“Still, I wouldn’t be surprised if (unlike many of his GOP competitors) Christie’s trajectory is still on the rise. There are a couple of reasons for this.
“First, Christie is the only contender who actually realizes the 2024 election is about one question and one question only: Trump or not Trump.
“This is to say, the 2024 GOP primary is not about who has the best 10-point policy plan or who is the most anti-woke. It’s simply about whether or not Republicans want Trump again.
“Christie is the only candidate whose strategy and message suggest he accepts this reality—and is acting accordingly. ...
“But what I do know is that Christie is the only Republican opponent who has the correct interpretation of what the primary is about. And that is a huge advantage.
“This also brings us to the second reason Christie has a chance to gain traction. He’s the only non-Trump candidate who is not only tough, but also funny and entertaining. ...”

| | | It's Marco. Please read this message to the end, but only if you're prepared to handle the reality of our situation. With only about 30% of folks opening these messages, I believe that by opening this, you're someone who can handle it. I know it's hard to tell fact from fiction these days, but I'm going to level with you and tell you the truth.

On top of only about 30% of our friends opening these messages, only about 1% will go the extra mile by donating. Conservatives like me rely on emails, texts, mail, and phone calls to raise money for our cause, so I'm humbly asking you to read this all the way through. If you still think your $1 doesn't matter, then I want to simply thank you for hearing me out.

**Here's the truth...**

The Democrats stopped our Red Wave in 2022, and we need every little bit if we want to fund the programs needed to win in 2024 - and we need it today.

I don't have deep-pocketed billionaires I can call on to hit these goals. I rely on a couple of bucks here and there from hard-working Americans receiving these messages when they can afford it.

**If everyone reading this chipped in just a little bit, we would be able to reach our goals and keep up with the Democrats' millions raised. I know it's not much, but all I need from you today is the price of a cup of coffee, a candy bar, or a donut.**

| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=7f823e7197394785b00e9fb2d237e7fa&_e=e4Z1nXyd3r2FxrKJHetnfzY4i6Y7It-VGkIIKCGETnVNcbSKxsx7qVuiDBS1i0DPQb6J9g9lcD9u4ShnJ0W_seE3lokWFfWHkUleI9dVjHzqLAus0113CaGCaDlylyREOlAbf1UhsyxC25Odl6q0PIizNVTLRPsmulStIVU7wnP7qBd4mkB-GvrTLstSHvxp9_bjbyv-IsqTYvuDYsvZYlllLGG-0QDupytCciWpTZiTLfz8NTMBrZNofLsOqB4YpYBimJ7Dhq6Oi62qF-ipMLMV2XkbufAvDkhWd9FwbY3jshZW-SJ1XrN5jXugKSzzEcLziDUTd7mpwkpSH2je0dLnz9cwnS39RwVf03VbzWaz8m2Gfp-_Nl1oCLOzkJJdK_mZTLtzfeOXKGQsb6UybjMDiygLrfKm5XUbzXDc1lA%3D) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=7f823e7197394785b00e9fb2d237e7fa&_e=e4Z1nXyd3r2FxrKJHetnfzY4i6Y7It-VGkIIKCGETnVNcbSKxsx7qVuiDBS1i0DPQb6J9g9lcD9u4ShnJ0W_seE3lokWFfWHkUleI9dVjHzqLAus0113CaGCaDlylyREOlAbf1UhsyxC25Odl6q0PIizNVTLRPsmulStIVU7wnP7qBd4mkB-GvrTLstSHvxp9_bjbyv-IsqTYvuDYsvZYlllLGG-0QDupytCciWpTZiTLfz8NTMBrZNofLsOqB4YpYBimJ7Dhq6Oi62qF-ipMKCsdR3-HZeV0nu0ODKgpjkDQPLfRK_Y-te922cMKf8zM7nEPOCMugz3nclvTYKiybGMAorUbjW7QPe5AKn1at6i7riY3BTHTuqagh1ffy8cgOAOPMMce8sSNIChQOSDqyn18a82EXqsa1VjbD3uD94%3D)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=7f823e7197394785b00e9fb2d237e7fa&_e=e4Z1nXyd3r2FxrKJHetnfzY4i6Y7It-VGkIIKCGETnVNcbSKxsx7qVuiDBS1i0DPQb6J9g9lcD9u4ShnJ0W_seE3lokWFfWHkUleI9dVjHzqLAus0113CaGCaDlylyREOlAbf1UhsyxC25Odl6q0PIizNVTLRPsmulStIVU7wnP7qBd4mkB-GvrTLstSHvxp9_bjbyv-IsqTYvuDYsvZYlllLGG-0QDupytCciWpTZiTLfz8NTMBrZNofLsOqB4YpYBimJ7Dhq6Oi62qF-ipMP04R2IFMc9BDe-HpCR4YrQoEtn5PtoYqm8jgw1cDbLIjrPxUlOKGheuCk86c6n0r8YsaNWw-lqOx49PEpqC0p5hJdX8oOklrwjEnFJnxhJYACaW3O5V1XniY_DJS-FaFCGMUXYIvuqE0UQ7wVphKJA%3D)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

body:
This is Democrats’ best chance to flip a Senate seat in 2024 — but we can’t do it without your help.
#
Peter — here are 5 reasons why you should donate $5 or more toward our goal of raising 30,000 individual donations before midnight TONIGHT:
1. **Lucas Kunce is our best chance to flip a U.S. Senate seat in 2024** — and after he launched his campaign to defeat Josh Hawley earlier this year, _National Journal_ even said our movement “represents one of the Democratic Party’s better offensive targets” this cycle.
2. **Josh Hawley’s cowardice on January 6th made him the GOP’s most vulnerable senator.** His support base in-state is crumbling and a recent report showed Hawley with a net-negative approval rating and a growing “intensely negative sentiment” among Missourians.
3. **Lucas’ bold message is already resonating with voters.** Whether it’s calling out Hawley for being a fraud or corrupt politicians for failing to actually serve the people they were elected to represent, Lucas has earned in-state and national media attention for speaking truth to power.
4. **National Republicans are attacking Lucas relentlessly.** Hawley’s campaign and GOP insiders at the NRSC know Lucas has the message + momentum to flip this seat — and they’re doing whatever it takes to tear him (and our grassroots movement) down before it’s too late.

| | | The Supreme Court is out of control. The ultra-right-wing majority is no longer interpreting the law, it is making up altogether, and forcing extremist policies in place of the ones most Americans actually support.

[**It's time to expand the Court. We need to empower President Biden to add members to create a majority that will once again do its proper job, not try to rule as kings.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb301d874-5ae9-43de-8437-0f154f2bf5cd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

There is nothing in the Constitution that says the Court must be nine members. It can be expanded through a simple majority vote in Congress. And with the ultra-extremist and unpopular positions taken by the Court recently, we could get those majorities if we show enough support. **Republicans would do it in a heartbeat if they had the chance, and it's time for us to go on offense for a change, and make this happen.**

[**Sign the petition, and show your support for expanding the Court and making it sane again.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tdd9c6183-3624-4151-8d1c-2517ce562eac/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Read the endorsement . “It is my enormous privilege to endorse President Donald Trump for re-election. Joining the first Trump campaign in its early days, I saw then what the whole world has learned since: that President Trump is a once-in-a-lifetime transformative leader who possesses the rare combination of skills, insights, wisdom and otherworldly determination necessary to save America from those who would destroy her. He left a life of comfort and wealth to endure abuse and persecution few can imagine. At so many points, at so many times, he could have walked away, spared himself, grabbed a golden parachute, but instead he sacrificed all he has built so that we might be free again. Doing more to change our politics than any leader since Andrew Jackson, Trump inherited a Republican Party that was globalist, donor-centric and unabashedly neoconservative — destined for a generations of nominees and party figureheads in the mold of George Bush and his protégés — a party whose zeal for unrestricted free trade, unceasing foreign wars and unending open immigration threatened to sink the whole American experiment. Trump saved the party from itself — and thus the hopes of America, by creating a political party vehicle for nationalist populism and America First patriotism. He delivered peace to a world at war. Prosperity to a country in decline. And he sealed the border in the face of domestic legal and political and international opposition on a scale that defies description. Whereas presidents of both parties before him laid down the welcome mat for global mass migration he banned travel from unsafe nations; ended refugee pipelines; suspended whole immigration programs; marshaled state power to stop visa overstays; restored consular affairs to a mission in defense of America not in support of foreign nationals; rewrote the foreign affairs manual to protect our interests; issued arguably the most important domestic regulation in history (public charge); and instituted the most comprehensive sovereign deportation strategy ever developed to end catch-and-release both at and between our ports, and across the whole US, to repatriate nationals to scores of countries across the globe — defeating a deep state and a leftwing judicial state that was hellbent on thwarting his each and every move. He achieved energy independence. Successfully implemented a more ambitious deregulatory agenda than any President in modern history. Restored tariffs to the fore of our economic arsenal, reviving the patriotic mercantilism that built the American economic powerhouse. He changed the entire paradigm on China. He changed the entire paradigm in the Middle East. He made millions of Americans felt seen and heard for the first time in their lives. And he did it all while battling a deep state coup. Now, the same forces who tried to frame him, who tried to remove him, who broke every rule in the book to try to stop him, are trying to jail him. Why? Because they know if he gets back into the Oval Office he will stop them. Stop them from cheating and bleeding and ransacking our country. Stop them from taking your voice and your vote. Stop them from illicitly spying and censoring and dragging us into military conflicts that yield only pain and hardship. So let us choose peace. Let us stand with the man who has always stood with us. Let us stand with President Trump, more now than ever.” | ---|--- Donald J. Trump June 29th, 2023 President Donald J. Friend, Our Founders gave Supreme Court justices lifetime appointments with the intention of ensuring impartiality and isolating the judges from external political and social pressures. Since then, however, the Court has become deeply politicized and dangerously incompatible with our nation’s highest ideals. From gutting voting rights to overturning _Roe v. Wade,_ SCOTUS is implementing anti-democratic decisions most Americans strongly oppose. And now, in the midst of the greatest affordability crisis in recent memory, the Supreme Court rejected student loan forgiveness, making it worse for people who are struggling the most. Lifetime appointments mean the Supreme Court will remain out of touch with popular opinion for decades to come. That’s why we need term limits for justices.

Peter, unlike Boebert, I’m counting on folks like you — not big corporate PACs or dark money groups — to win this.
I know this will be a hard-fought primary, but my campaign is up to the challenge. I’m a veterinarian, a mom, and a small-business owner. Over 59% of primary voters are women, and the majority live in rural or working-class communities. The right candidate with rural roots who can speak to our district’s values can gain the traction needed to turn the seat blue.
While my primary opponent got close to beating Boebert last cycle, he failed to get the job done. And here’s the truth — of the 56 rematch races in 2020, only five had a different outcome than in 2018. This seat is sure to be a challenge for any Democrat, but data from previous rematches clearly shows that a fresh nominee has the best chance of winning what will be a competitive and targeted race in the general election.
It’s going to take a truly people-powered campaign to flip this seat and give Western and Southern Colorado a representative who understands their struggles and matches their values. Missing our end-of-quarter fundraising goal would mean missing our chance to kick Boebert out of Congress and elect someone who’ll actually put our families first.
Don’t sit this one out, Peter! Please rush a donation to help us close the final gap to our end-of-quarter target right now. » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2306_q2_eoq?refcode2=link_CTA2]
Let’s crush this,
Debby
Dr. Debby Burnett is running to represent Colorado’s 3rd District in Congress. As a veterinarian for 20+ years, she’s worked with farmers and ranchers across our district to improve their lives and their livelihoods. As the mother of a 16-year-old, she knows how to get 20 things done at once. And as a rural Coloradan who owns a small agricultural business, she understands what the people of Western and Southern Colorado need — and that’s why she’s stepping up to give them a real voice in Congress.

Believe it or not, these early months are some of the most critical — they set the course for the entire campaign. Your support now sends a powerful message about the strength of the movement we’re building — and it’ll help Joe and Kamala prepare for anything coming their way.
And Peter, trust me — we need to be prepared for anything.
Our democracy is at stake right now. In the last few years, we’ve seen a backlash against democratic ideals. Through gerrymandering, attempts to silence and intimidate the press, and attacks against ideas and rules just because they don’t suit a certain few, we’re seeing a dangerous strand of anti-democratic sentiment. We’ve got to fight back against it.
**I know we will, Peter. That’s why I remain optimistic, because our democracy depends on our engagement.** In 2020, Americans reaffirmed their belief in our democracy at the ballot box by electing Joe and Kamala, and in 2024, we have the chance to do it again.

Holder said, “Fighting for fair maps helped save our democracy. **But this is not a one-and-done effort.** ” That’s why NDRC is looking toward the future and working to secure, enforce, and improve fair redistricting reforms in states like Arizona, Ohio, Virginia, and Wisconsin.

The Supreme Court has been hijacked by right-wing extremists. And they are imposing their deeply unpopular views upon the rest of our country. Overturning Roe v. Wade. Loosening gun safety restrictions. Rejecting President Biden’s legal authority to cancel student debt and making it easier to discriminate against the LGBTQIA+ community. Substituting politics for the rule of law. It deeply troubles me to think how six justices could care so little about the people who will pay the price of these decisions. The Republican party has been scheming this takeover for decades — but an out-of-touch, out-of-control Court doesn’t get the last word. We the people do. I’m going to keep speaking out on the big, bold ideas we need to take to stop this injustice — like expanding the Supreme Court to rebalance it, ending the filibuster, and fixing the Electoral College. In the meantime, I’m also going to stay focused on making sure people can still get student debt relief — because the president has more tools he can use to make it happen. And I’ll keep working to ensure the right to an abortion, from supporting statewide ballot initiative campaigns to fighting to codify Roe into federal law. I’m angry — but I’m not giving up hope. We can make sure that our government actually protects our freedoms and works for working people — not just the people who can afford to take Supreme Court justices on a lavish yacht vacation. body:
Help us finish June with strength!

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeGlgXqOx-Y

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

Black women carry more debt than any other group in America -- and carry it the longest. Black borrowers have nearly twice as much student debt ($52,700) after four years of college as our white peers ($28,000). **This racist, bigoted right-wing majority also doesn’t care about our LGBTQ+ siblings.** The decision to side with an evangelical Christian graphic artist from Colorado who does not want to create wedding websites for same-sex couples, despite the state’s protective anti-discrimination law, is just another excuse to punish our communities and enforce a white supremist religious patriarchy on everyone. [**We have a mandate to ensure our rights are not stripped away to implement a fascist and hateful agenda. I’m proud to lead on the _Judiciary Act_ , which would expand the Court and help us reclaim our democracy once and for all. To make it happen, I need your help to build support. name: Defend the Constitution
subject: Former Home Depot CEO issues dire warning for Americans
body:
Something strange is happening in our financial system.

| Dear Reader, Something strange is happening in our financial system. According to analysts at UBS, more than 50,000 retail locations could shut their doors in the months ahead. Already, Walmart, Foot Locker, Bed Bath & Beyond, and Macy's are cutting stores. And former Home Depot CEO Bob Nardelli recently issued a grim warning:
> "We're going to see a lot of bankruptcies. [This is] different than anything I have seen in my 52 years..."
What does it all mean for your family and your money? Dr. Nomi Prins has dug deeper into the research, and she's found something startling. Amid all the turmoil predicted by Nardeni and UBS, Prins has found a single firm that could be the canary in the coal mine foreshadowing the next major crisis in America. body:
Min Leads Likely Republican Opponent Scott Baugh +7 (43-36)

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/dc108ca48d01/icymi-last-weeks-poll-showed-dave-min-in-strong-position-to-win-ca47-general-election-15658032?e=7017cc100e)

For Immediate Release: June 30, 2023
Contact: press@davemin.com (mailto:press@davemin.com)

ICYMI: Last Week’s Poll Showed Dave Min
In Strong PositionTo Win CA47 General Election
Min Leads Likely Republican Opponent Scott Baugh +7 (43-36)

IRVINE, CA — Last week, a new poll released by Public Policy Polling among likely General Election voters in California’s 47th Congressional District showed State Senator Dave Min in a strong position to defeat likely Republican nominee Scott Baugh in 2024.

Voters responded overwhelmingly to Min’s unique story. The son of Korean immigrants, Min has a record of service as a former Law Enforcement Attorney for the SEC and as a current State Senator who represents 85% of the Congressional District. After the candidate’s biographies are read, Min leads Baugh by +4 (41-37), and expands his leads to +7 (43-36) after negative messaging is introduced.

To Read The Full Polling Memo Click Here (https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vS0USA0SGSRHz0jqyEQM8IU2ySeL6BKGA51u_SGXGj7EFKCZ2ngJJeLucBhWHlykekiGTTD9l8fDKjl/pub)

Outlets reported on the results last week. Andrew Sheeler from The Sacramento Bee (https://www.sacbee.com/news/politics-government/capitol-alert/article276584681.html) reported that “...State Sen. Dave Min’s campaign to replace Irvine Democratic Congresswoman Katie Porter next year appears to be holding strong.” The Daily Kos (https://www.dailykos.com/stories/2023/6/21/2176561/-Morning-Digest-Virginia-Democrats-breathe-sigh-of-relief-as-Joe-Morrissey-finally-gets-turfed) continued that, in the head-to-head between Min and Baugh, “the memo says that Min pulls ahead after respondents hear about each of their biographies.”

Min’s recent DUI flatlined with voters as a salient attack. When likely voters were informed about Scott Baugh's negatives, namely that he has faced more than 20 criminal charges for perjury and campaign finance violations, 65% of likely voters thought this was a convincing reason to vote against him, and 49% found this very convincing.

By way of comparison, while Min's DUI earlier this year caused some observers to question his viability as a candidate, the poll found that this incident was clearly not a significant factor for voters. Only 19% of likely voters found this to be a very convincing line of attack, while 47% found this not at all convincing. After voters were informed about the negative messages for both candidates, Min’s lead grew from 4% to 7%.

The news of the public polling comes on the heels of Min announcing the endorsement from the largest local law enforcement association in California, adding to his impressive coalition of support which includes 125 local, state, and federal leaders, SEIU, the California Federation of Teachers and the Congressional Asian Pacific Islander Caucus’ ASPIRE PAC in endorsing Dave Min for Congress in California’s 47th Congressional District.

Senator Min, the only Korean-American in the state legislature, serves as Chair of the Senate Natural Resources and Water Committee and as Senate Vice Chair of the Asian and Pacific Islander Legislative Caucus. Min, who was formerly a law professor at UC Irvine School of Law and has three children in Irvine public schools, also serves on the Senate’s Budget Subcommittee for Education, which oversees all budget funding for California’s public schools, community colleges, the California State University system, and the University of California system.

Min has proven himself an incredibly effective legislative leader in the Senate, authoring 16 bills signed into law by the Governor, including leading legislation on hate crimes (https://timesofsandiego.com/opinion/2022/03/13/2-bills-before-the-legislature-will-help-stop-anti-asian-hate-crimes-in-california/) , gun violence prevention (https://www.latimes.com/socal/daily-pilot/news/story/2022-07-25/bill-aiming-to-ban-gun-shows-sales-on-state-land-hits-target) , family safety, and women’s reproductive rights (https://www.ocregister.com/2022/07/14/california-judges-able-to-renew-domestic-violence-protection-orders-under-new-law/) , and procuring over $70 million in direct appropriations for priorities in his district, including for fire response, parks and open spaces, and climate innovation. In the wake of the 2021 Huntington Beach Oil Spill, he stood up to the oil industry and led efforts to end offshore drilling
(https://spectrumnews1.com/ca/la-west/news/2022/04/26/sb-953-aims-to-end-drilling-off-state-shores) . Min sits on two key environmental committees, chairing the Natural Resources and Water Committee and serving on the Energy and Utilities Committee, as well as the Budget Committee, the Budget Subcommittee for Education, the Judiciary Committee, and the Banking and Financial Institutions Committee. Senator Min previously served as Chair of the Select Committee on Cybersecurity.

Before entering the State Senate, Min was a law professor at UC Irvine, where he taught and researched in the area of business law. He resides with his wife Jane Stoever, a UC Irvine law professor who specializes in domestic violence and family law, and their three children in Irvine. Dave is a native Californian, a product of California public schools who graduated from the Wharton School and Harvard Law School, and an Eagle Scout.

#####

California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country.

This is Ava, Marlene’s daughter.

19 years ago, my mom and dad brought me into our family from Guatemala. Growing up, mom has been my biggest cheerleader. She's also right by my side whenever life is hard.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65702557/414293473/1924984212?refcode=em-6.30.23-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYwODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzgyMmE0OWUtNjgxNy1lZTExLWE5YmItMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=kTIG_zGfR3dPvFIpjfTwkOScqz9ebGOzfITUYkzvBBo=)

Like most people my age, I worry about the future of our country. We’re worried about finding decent jobs. We worry about our planet. And now we have to worry about politicians who are taking away our rights over our own bodies. That’s not okay with me __or__ my mom.

This Schweikert guy she is running against is bad news all around. He’s been in office longer than I’ve been alive and, from what I can tell, has only been out for himself.

My mom is the strongest person I know. She would make an incredible representative in Congress. But she has a major fundraising deadline tomorrow.

body:
The President has the authority to cancel debt. Period.
#
The Supreme Court just overturned President Biden’s plan to cancel student loan debt.
But the fight is not over. [The President can still cancel student loan debt — and we need your help to push him to act, NOW, before payments resume in the Fall.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/sign/student-debt-crisis?source=em20230630-4563-&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4563%2E2526796%2EO-Jf79)
**[Sign our letter to the President →](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/sign/student-debt-crisis?source=em20230630-4563-&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4563%2E2526796%2EO-Jf79)**
Without debt cancellation, the restart of payments in September will result in financial disaster. Before the pause, 9 million borrowers were in default, and 1 in 4 borrowers were behind on payments. President Biden needs to use every authority he has to stop this economic catastrophe, as soon as possible.
**Congress already gave the President the authority to cancel student debt when it passed the Higher Education Act.** There’s a clear precedent. In 2022, the Department of Education was able to cancel at least $6 billion in debt for Americans who were defrauded by for-profit universities.
[Sign our letter today to ask President Biden to provide student loan relief NOW, before payments resume in the Fall. **[Sign our letter to the President →](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/sign/student-debt-crisis?source=em20230630-4563-&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=4563%2E2526796%2EO-Jf79)** In solidarity, Team AOC

Friend, Yesterday, the corrupt majority on the U.S. Supreme Court ruled to greenlight discrimination in our education system by overturning 45 years of precedent. By striking down affirmative action, justices ignored hundreds of years of slavery and decades of Jim Crow, deciding that generational violence and inequality no longer play a part in society. **This will have devastating consequences on those who have been historically excluded, undervalued, and overlooked―especially Black, brown, and Indigenous students.** But the court was not done. Today, SCOTUS blocked President Biden from implementing his student debt relief plan, despite the president’s clear legal authority to do so. Biden’s plan would have provided $10,000 in relief for federal education debt for anyone who made less than $125,000 in 2020 or 2021—and to cancel an additional $10,000 for anyone who received Federal Pell Grants. It is important to note that education debt is a racial and social justice issue. **Loans with high interest rates keep people mired in debt their whole lives, simply for seeking higher education.** Student loans widen the racial wealth gap and disproportionately harm Black women. **Thankfully, there is still plenty that the Biden administration can do.** Instead of citing a national emergency to cancel education debt, which the Supreme Court just struck down, the president can instead cite the _Higher Education Act of 1965_ , which covers federal aid programs including student loans and provides the Secretary of Education with the ability to waive federal education loans.1 [**Sign now and tell the Biden administration to use the**** _Higher Education Act of 1965_****to cancel student debt!**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnmlf9yb9ilux69QpyOCfiDu7Cgf6kblfqztBVlWi-c9EtKG5CrvDA7Bp4XNLkpY3rCgFlX181Nl1RScV-Z-4xV066M-T_HyFWzgB7Wo5gSozf_DTFG2_NhIWh6mk2wxz0uFS7kB7JO5bD2bLKSkoE6vsSWyeXMGS1d5tBbRlxX4H7b4-CqagKN3s8bbiAY9qXnI5I9bLCRnK1WjDKUw7yaPIFNpnIQJlSsTgxfnuaerTmWmOLWn8QComEbMeo1kK7Z6pI1Zs6tUqcQs0k4xECNzficKd6piXL5oEuhkhrw6ZKucMBb5V5NrTbthRq4r9fnAmZdIP-vkcUj_kgFKfTv6rtZ7hlhq9brxlUZY6tnz2zaJL1bafTDJmuAnycTnTU2FxkHZQbg-lfQdk7T_tYJ-dMaPyAKAY82Ahe27rRJYSA/3xh/9H8oMDPnRlenmmOWDw4wWA/h1/lgtWYVT0SD20cA3Smmz10jCpR3NgdlyuhwHcClpWyA0) | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnmlf9yb9ilux69QpyOCfiDu7Cgf6kblfqztBVlWi-c9EtKG5CrvDA7Bp4XNLkpY3rCgFlX181Nl1RScV-Z-4xV066M-T_HyFWzgB7Wo5gSozf_DTFG2_NhIWh6mk2wxz0shJOvvyoPn0P37CX0sGgT1Sb5kMgMH-oyGXNnwPlXHgRAyDAyB-GoIKjz2CImTzNzVRkzj8omXQoBk6f5Q9F28C1OUhl_r5HMbOYtdCuf9MRhpzmArAkwrmEg3f4PqtE095JfzVE75pH4Y2ElxCCM1F0yZCS4uc2HyXdJmGgnvrJrxFHiBv41zMhZSibcuhu_AR4nM2xuDB-kr3wVKqrOFnYe17SSYRQ1TpGvTffTgZ8S-N8f8MrbzdNTkM3FWQ45CQpC7mMF8N6FHP0PFruqHBdpYTAEgy6gTiJC4Kw8Fsg/3xh/9H8oMDPnRlenmmOWDw4wWA/h2/amRiWnbtIWknWu6eWSdWRShFrLwjsPelgK18hzLgr6g)

**Right now, nearly 45 million Americans are saddled with education debt, which further entrenches systemic racism and the cycle of poverty.**

Meanwhile, billionaires are buying Supreme Court justices, including hedge fund billionaire Paul Singer who funded the lawsuits against student debt relief. ProPublica recently reported that Singer took Justice Alito on a luxury fishing vacation to Alaska worth hundreds of thousands of dollars that Alito never reported.2
At the same time, Justice Clarence Thomas failed to disclose that billionaire GOP donor Harlan Crow paid for Thomas’s nephew’s private school education.3 **Apparently, Justice Thomas has no problem secretly taking payments from billionaires to pay for his own family’s education while tens of millions of working class Americans are denied the ability to begin families, buy homes, and build generational wealth.**
[**Take action today to fight back against Supreme Court rulings that put the wants of billionaires ahead of the needs of millions of Americans. Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan.

In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game.

Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. Congressman Walker and his wife Kelly, a Family Nurse Practitioner and flight trauma specialist, have been married for thirty years and have three children.
