**As it stands, the Supreme Court’s decision has left 44 million people,****_a generation of borrowers_****, under the burden of crushing student loan debt that stands at a record high of $1.7 trillion.** It has also left widening gender, racial, and generational wealth gaps firmly in place. The ruling falls disproportionately on Black borrowers, especially Black women, who will still owe an average of 95% of their original student loan balance — _20 years after starting college_. **This is a kick in the teeth to working people across the nation.** It’s a clear signal that the court has been captured by reactionary right-wing forces who want nothing more than to keep people in misery, and to make it impossible for people to take collective action to improve their lives. Over the last two years, this court has overturned decades of precedent to undermine abortion rights, workers' rights, and to stop the government from taking action against climate change and gun violence. Our fight is not over, though.**** We can’t shrug our shoulders and give up — we need the White House to use every tool to provide working people with the student debt relief they need, including reissuing the student loan cancellation plan under a different legal authority: **the Higher Education Act.** Passed by Congress in 1965, the Higher Education Act authorizes the President, via the Secretary of Education, to "enforce, pay, compromise, waive, or release" government-held federal student loans. That means Biden could still wipe out existing federal student loans under these provisions — and likely, not face any legal barriers in the courts. Still, however, this could take weeks, months, or maybe even a year to accomplish. On top of that, after more than three years and eight extensions, the Department of Education has announced that the pause on federal student loan repayment is ending later this summer, under the terms of the debt-ceiling deal negotiated by President Joe Biden and House Speaker Kevin McCarthy. The transition back onto repayment plans won’t be easy, Peter. Millions of borrowers are already struggling to stay afloat amid rising costs of living, and student loan payments will push many to the edge of a financial cliff, if not off of it. **That’s why we’re urging President Biden to meet this moment with the urgency necessary, and reissue his student loan cancellation plan under the Higher Education Act immediately.**[**Sign our petition clean_body: We’re urging President Joe Biden to immediately sign another executive order and reissue his student loan cancellation plan under the Higher Education Act. | | | Peter, Just moments ago the Supreme Court ruled against the Biden administration's student loan forgiveness plan. As it stands, the Supreme Court’s decision has left 44 million people,a generation of borrowers, under the burden of crushing student loan debt that stands at a record high of $1.7 trillion. It has also left widening gender, racial, and generational wealth gaps firmly in place. The ruling falls disproportionately on Black borrowers, especially Black women, who will still owe an average of 95% of their original student loan balance — 20 years after starting college. This is a kick in the teeth to working people across the nation. It’s a clear signal that the court has been captured by reactionary right-wing forces who want nothing more than to keep people in misery, and to make it impossible for people to take collective action to improve their lives. Over the last two years, this court has overturned decades of precedent to undermine abortion rights, workers' rights, and to stop the government from taking action against climate change and gun violence. Our fight is not over, though.** We can’t shrug our shoulders and give up — we need the White House to use every tool to provide working people with the student debt relief they need, including reissuing the student loan cancellation plan under a different legal authority: the Higher Education Act. Passed by Congress in 1965, the Higher Education Act authorizes the President, via the Secretary of Education, to "enforce, pay, compromise, waive, or release" government-held federal student loans. That means Biden could still wipe out existing federal student loans under these provisions — and likely, not face any legal barriers in the courts. Still, however, this could take weeks, months, or maybe even a year to accomplish. On top of that, after more than three years and eight extensions, the Department of Education has announced that the pause on federal student loan repayment is ending later this summer, under the terms of the debt-ceiling deal negotiated by President Joe Biden and House Speaker Kevin McCarthy. The transition back onto repayment plans won’t be easy, Peter. Millions of borrowers are already struggling to stay afloat amid rising costs of living, and student loan payments will push many to the edge of a financial cliff, if not off of it. That’s why we’re urging President Biden to meet this moment with the urgency necessary, and reissue his student loan cancellation plan under the Higher Education Act immediately. Heidi sponsored or co-sponsored over 100 pieces of legislation in her first year in the senate, including legislation to allow cities to offer paid family leave, increase funding for school counselors and reading interventionists, and make it easier to cast a vote.

body:
A social agenda has no place within our armed forces...

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c27883%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=DmSx%2bqhLyYyVahs7yxv3aA&sysid=1)
---
Friend, I'm running for President because I don't believe the decline of our country is inevitable. I believe it's a choice that stands before us. **We have it in our power to choose a better path --a path that's going to lead to the revival of this country and a restoration of American Greatness.**
---
| | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA--JOIN THE FIGHT](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c27884%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=gqhaiRaXhvdlqscFwJxe2w&sysid=1)
---
I believe in this American Greatness, friend. I’ve spent my life fighting for it. Long before I was elected governor, I served our nation in Iraq as a JAG officer in support of SEAL Team 1. Having seen what the attacks of September 11th did to our country, I felt a responsibility to do my part to help at a time of struggle. _**So I served**_. Friend, the sense of satisfaction I got knowing that I was wearing the cloth of my country, serving alongside so many honorable patriots, and fighting for something bigger than myself was a satisfaction that money just can't buy. Today, our country has lost its sense of national pride.
* Instead of strengthening our military recruiting efforts and building a military for the future...
* Instead of securing our border and holding Mexican drug cartels accountable for the irrevocable harm they’ve done to our citizens...
* And instead of reigning in out-of-control economic and fiscal policy that have left us on the brink of bankruptcy...

...**the Left has been too busy distracting our nation with the woke Olympics.** I find this unacceptable. _**I am ready to keep my campaign promises, restore an energetic executive to the White House, and get the job done**_. I recently took my message directly to the people of Iowa, New Hampshire, and South Carolina, and I will continue to spread the message each and every day until we’ve won...until we’ve righted this ship...until we’ve achieved our Great American Comeback.
---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c27895%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=s0W3%2bgjEJsmW7F9aMUhSfw&sysid=1)
---

This cannot stand. **[Will you fight with me?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c27896%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=3m4Y3fgLZp8qhchyEQA5aw&sysid=1 "Will you fight with

**Meet Ron DeSantis**
---
| | | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c27898%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=c5dpYDvVmheHFzFCwmoCgQ&sysid=1)
---
| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the “Russia collusion” conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what’s right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn’t popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America’s founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation’s revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden’s border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn’t stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: “When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism.”

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor’s leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration’s overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor’s vision, this year’s legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida’s history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state’s infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden’s border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they’re the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

body:
Friends,

I wanted to remind you again why this race to flip CA-40 blue is so important and what’s on the line:

– Reproductive rights
– Gun violence reform
– Addressing climate change
– Strengthening our middle class
– Affordable healthcare

There’s a lot that we need to fight for, friends. Particularly, for folks whose voices and lives have been marginalized for too long by politicians like Young Kim, who believe that the right to life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness belongs only to those who look, worship, and love as they do.

Right now, we have less than 12 hours to meet the end-of-quarter fundraising deadline. Can you pitch in before 9 P.M. Pacific Time and help my campaign flip CA-40 blue?

DONATE >> https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_email_2023q2?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2023.06.30_B1_EOQ2

As you know, I’m up against Young Kim, who is anti-everything we should stand for as a country.

Enough is enough. Enough gun violence, enough taking away people's rights to live as their authentic selves, enough telling women what to do with their bodies, and enough of pretending a climate crisis does not exist.

We need to stand up for our values. We need to stand up for our communities to have the rights for ALL citizens to thrive in an inclusive and safe democracy.

Please contribute before 9 P.M. Pacific Time today and help my campaign and me flip CA-40 so that we can fight for these causes.

DONATE >> https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_email_2023q2?refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2023.06.30_B1_EOQ2

This pride month, I was proud to stand with the LGBTQ+ community’s efforts to fight for equitable rights. My family and I were honored to march alongside activists and community leaders in the OC Pride Parade earlier this month.

It was a joyous celebration and a reminder that when we stand together for each other, LOVE WINS!

Thank you again for all your help, friends. It means the world to me.

– Allyson

Friends, before we head into the Fourth of July weekend (and before you rightfully turn off your email notifications), I hope you’ll read this brief note.
The upcoming holiday is a good reminder that keeping our democracy means participating and protecting it from those who wish to bend it to their will or destroy it outright.

From all the volunteers who’ve helped us knock on doors over the years, to all the grassroots donors who help us hit our goals, to all the voters who take the time to go to the polls or mail in their ballots – thank you for continuing to show up and show your support.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

Peter,

| Meet **Mark Walker**

Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan.

In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game.

Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. Congressman Walker and his wife Kelly, a Family Nurse Practitioner and flight trauma specialist, have been married for thirty years and have three children.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

At Granite Solutions, we believe in the power of organization, local action, and shared responsibility. It's how we work together to safeguard the future of New Hampshire.

Today, we're reaching out with a unique opportunity that embodies these principles - [becoming a Town or Ward Captain for Granite Solutions.](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.granitesolutions.org%2Fvolunteer/1/010001890d9280af-dad89869-a89d-421c-93b2-b4150a9b15d1-000000/j94KmlNrAaeOIRj9S6EZDHcwycQ=328)

By stepping into this role, you can make a significant impact in your community and our state. You will be the cornerstone of our "get organized to stay organized" ethos, driving our conservative mission forward.

As a Granite Solutions Town or Ward Captain, your responsibilities will include:

* Organizing and executing local initiatives to amplify our conservative message and mission.
* Collaborating with the Granite Solutions team to plan local events and gatherings.
* Acting as a liaison between Granite Solutions and your community, helping us stay connected and responsive.

* Playing a key role in volunteer and candidate recruitment - helping us identify and support the next generation of conservative leaders.

[Our Town and Ward Captains aren't just volunteers - they are leaders, building and nurturing our grassroots network across New Hampshire. And you won't be alone - you'll have our full support every step of the way.](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.granitesolutions.org%2Fvolunteer/3/010001890d9280af-dad89869-a89d-421c-93b2-b4150a9b15d1-000000/dhZE60tzGJ5-51nk9KjhQZnRyZA=328)[

If you're ready to lead, to get organized, and to make a difference for New Hampshire's future, [then click here to sign up and become a Town or Ward Captain for Granite Solutions.](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.granitesolutions.org%2Fvolunteer/5/010001890d9280af-dad89869-a89d-421c-93b2-b4150a9b15d1-000000/fFvc6pj7XkDl3Lna_DAyr10q4gc=328)

subject: How do you see the Supreme Court?
body:
Your participation in Hillsdale College's National Survey on the United States Supreme Court is requested.

| | |
---
| | This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zs8gafn1iujcjlcldijeqok4aog3rq7f05vsjhjo_rp22sh2s8i66o70shhm2oj4c5h2bs)
---
| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
[YES](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zcfq8f0prhbrgkmhv80cmn2h5sf7tram8r3rahe0_rp22sh2s8i66o70shhm2oj4c5h2bs) [NO](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z2a4r6lkrl1pepsp5v21e174ms96plghsc7h8ss0_rp22sh2s8i66o70shhm2oj4c5h2bs) Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats."

What is your opinion about the Supreme Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** using this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z4a7h12jehi8njnp6o2fejrto3im141rs5vqvfp8_rp22sh2s8i66o70shhm2oj4c5h2bs)**

And after you give your views, I hope you will consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The failure of too many of America's schools to provide young people with a proper education in American history and government makes it easier for progressives to **undermine** the separation of powers at the heart of limited government.

I'm sure you agree that too many Americans do not understand the role of an independent judiciary in preserving our constitutional order.

That's why Hillsdale College has expanded its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly **reaching** and **teaching** millions of Americans in all 50 states--including yours!

These efforts counter the influence of anti-American ideology being taught in classrooms all across America.

Your support will help us to expand our educational outreach, including:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution" and "The U.S. Supreme Court."

* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty.

* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens, teachers, and students in K-12 schools across America.

* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by launching and providing ongoing guidance to over 70 classical K-12 charter schools nationwide that offer a strong American history and civics curriculum.

We **undertake our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty** --as we do all of our work--without accepting a penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

That means all of our work--including reaching and teaching millions about America's great heritage of liberty--depends entirely on the support of Americans like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Please share your thoughts with Hillsdale using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court **right away--the link is below.

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zsgopr9sq5gp9m35oapkkt2t7soqthdouk87al68_rp22sh2s8i66o70shhm2oj4c5h2bs)

Then please consider giving a generous tax-deductible gift to preserve liberty for future generations through education.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth - Defending Liberty since 1844

clean_body: Quick note for my Husband... | | | | | | | Friend, This is Susan Hutchinson. My husband and I deeply appreciate your support of our campaign for President. We truly could not do this without you. I am reaching out because this week Asa and his campaign manager, Rob, both sent you an email regarding our first end-of-quarter fundraising goal . . . and I wanted to ask what you can do to help. Our campaign is still roughly $1,100 short of its Q2 fundraising goal. I can't begin to express how important it is that our campaign hits its fundraising goals. Asa and I know we have a challenging year ahead of us, but we are willing to make that sacrifice if it means we can provide a better future for our children and grandchildren. The only way to fix our country is if we all make some personal sacrifices. I'm asking that you to consider another contribution to help us meet our immediate goal. Today is the last day to donate for this quarter; our deadline is 12:00 AM tonight. Please consider helping Asa reach his first end-of-quarter fundraising goal. Donate whatever you can to help below. | "DONATE $25" We are blessed to have received support and encouraging words from so many of you. We will never stop fighting for our shared values! **To: President Biden
From: Peter
Subject: Thank you!** Dear President Biden,

For the last 2 years, you’ve fearlessly led the country out of a pandemic, through Republican extremism, and forward into progress.

**Because of your leadership, we’re all far better off than we were before you became president.**

I’m running for reelection so I can keep fighting for workers and families in the Senate – but I need your help. Analysts at _CNN_ say I’m one of the most vulnerable senators on the ballot – and national Republicans are already launching attack ads against me.
**The battle for Senate control could all come down to Ohio – so please, I’m personally asking: [Will you give $3 or more before our FEC deadline tonight to help defend this battleground seat and keep the Senate blue?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65713132/414322936/691330013?amounts=250,100,50,25,3&amount=3&refcode=jtk297-fr-nd-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MTkyMDQwMy03OTE3LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JD46i5yoS3zKxeUJdzcPt0wC5vXD6II1BffeKk_CzqI=)**

But I’m facing my toughest race yet – in a state Donald Trump won by 8 points. Last year’s Ohio Senate race was one of the most costly and competitive in the nation, and _NBC News_ reports that this one could be “even nastier and more expensive.”
**The long and short of it is, I can’t win – and Democrats simply can’t hold onto our narrow Senate majority – if we don’t have strong grassroots support from folks like you.**

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65713463/414324228/227139380?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZTI5Y2Q4ZS03OTE3LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KZjSROR0bLEHBtRHG9wwheWVrJRsgKoaxpHqmScenCQ=&emci=462e3937-4c17-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=de29cd8e-7917-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=43566853)

| | The FEC is breathing down my neck, Peter.

Our second fiscal quarter fundraising report is due at midnight, and to be quite honest, we’re not nearly where we need to be.

As the finance director for the Democratic Party of Georgia, it’s my job to make sure that the money is coming in, and right now, donations have slowed to a trickle.

[**_So I’m coming to you with an important ask: Will you join our grassroots team in supporting the Georgia Dems today? We need as many donors from across the country as possible.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65713464/414324229/710125701?refcode=20230630.2_BH_6AR&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZTI5Y2Q4ZS03OTE3LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KZjSROR0bLEHBtRHG9wwheWVrJRsgKoaxpHqmScenCQ=)**_

Everyone has their eyes on Georgia right now. The GOP just held a MAGA convention with Donald Trump, Kari Lake, and Marjorie Taylor Greene right here in Columbus, GA. Vice President Harris was here last month. _**They’re all going to be watching for our numbers.**_

Friend, From Detroit to Palestine, Rashida is leading the fight in Congress for human rights. **Just this week, Rashida led a letter to the Biden administration, joined by 18 of her colleagues, in urging the administration to reject Israel’s request for participation in the Visa Waiver Program.** Israel continually denies travel visas to Arab Americans, Palestinian Americans, and those who advocate for Palestinian rights. As the letter states:
> _"The Visa Waiver Program statutorily requires 'reciprocal privileges to citizens and nationals of the United States.' The reciprocity requirement cannot be met until equal treatment and freedom of travel is guaranteed for all U.S. citizens regardless of national origin, ethnicity, or religion._**_Israel’s continuous discrimination and mistreatment of Arab Americans, including Palestinian Americans, and others espousing support for Palestinian human rights, seeking to enter the country precludes their participation._**_"_
In fact, in 2019, Rashida was denied entry into Palestine by the Israeli government because of her support of Palestinian rights―denying Rashida the right to visit her _sity_ (grandmother), for what would likely have been the last time. Today marks an important day for Rashida’s re-election campaign. **Tonight at midnight we’ll close the books on a critical fundraising deadline** ―reporting on how much our campaign has raised and spent, and how much cash-on-hand we have available to take on the Super PACs and special interests who want to maintain the unjust status quo. [**Rush a donation today, before midnight, to support Rashida’s fight for human rights in Congress and to show the power of our national movement for change.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953wZOimZKtFKpmJWSsttHoM58jpBY0G5AY0KqZLlQjOfrkcMkLW2ZDWM2rztdzkZip0VV3Nf8i47Sg1za0jIIMRGthn-U6DdM9bS3PXDs1ZvMMlL_tpF_4XdNB3IfVGz2CCBxwnP2SBiyOxacx0K1yn3i87kz-ynT0gHaHajKE4_tIhNfYS7Vh_nCI82aCtEEWIxko4vYegfTM7FZLAy1pkoO8yNHCsiyUChnD332Hrk3KWBMwsjERZs59gZ_22QcpZIPkpmCNaO85Lmsx6sifT5WObh8AhpHFsv1v2CSoIuiDkhA09gsBbYJFQFXf76xEqn0QVXZo9e-HmKnaETSLEaK-1inKPJbZ6Q3EbErwibWqMZrqDdKZaXnLkCUih2VA91Bff8h-xvTUw-Sd3OfjNf63dbCd9giUAGnObAXJjSHg/3xh/Quww-xg4TfKZyfxrFfq0VQ/h1/M-1AVeTFxs3ojcm1OP0rdOdilypZAKYFmUk71xe8BT0) | [RUSH A DONATION](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953wZOimZKtFKpmJWSsttHoM58jpBY0G5AY0KqZLlQjOfrvPDbbSi1xoWeGDqBZzuQ793e9L7Y6AXpvMJxePQJBU7TUs_-ZN-90XUnqx_nzrNGRhQgnVNyCiIq4JBglndzTkNkk8UL4oddmNsKbOpCAq-o74yioIQjiY3JMme61OE_AJKfHA-Ewrg27ZJ9FA9FWOqRcyeXQCbQ_PrDfXQILyY9rvt0je4DzvKY_2yDpnKL_vayDncw38LxV0YNeXxF_qa9LlsIn1Lc98ALqDqHKMWij2crSDRX2-jWopom9u7tCfF2D80Z0U53_iU1uVgHVNqFkj0mgnLQUzikwBr7OiJuwSYvAi5A-C115Qx_DMrbI46wEFe2T5FkToXthPlWhZIrHrLV0jjIIgEUSeu0s_NCwIGmmjrd6q3-qWySJSR-Q/3xh/Quww-xg4TfKZyfxrFfq0VQ/h2/32ZVVlrRTxIoAQcITuafnFalGA8Gh1WsQGGVBHjH3Kw)

Last year, an AIPAC-aligned Super PAC spent more than $1 million in mailers and TV and digital ads in an attempt to defeat Rashida and attack her record of fighting for her district.

Rashida regularly drafts legislation in partnership with her residents. Just this month, Rashida re-introduced her _Prohibit Auto Insurance Discrimination Act (PAID Act)_ , to stop insurance companies from using non-driving factors when determining insurance rates and eligibility. clean_body: Today marks an important day for Rashida’s re-election campaign. | | | Friend, From Detroit to Palestine, Rashida is leading the fight in Congress for human rights. Just this week, Rashida led a letter to the Biden administration, joined by 18 of her colleagues, in urging the administration to reject Israel’s request for participation in the Visa Waiver Program. Israel continually denies travel visas to Arab Americans, Palestinian Americans, and those who advocate for Palestinian rights. As the letter states: "The Visa Waiver Program statutorily requires 'reciprocal privileges to citizens and nationals of the United States.' The reciprocity requirement cannot be met until equal treatment and freedom of travel is guaranteed for all U.S. citizens regardless of national origin, ethnicity, or religion.Israel’s continuous discrimination and mistreatment of Arab Americans, including Palestinian Americans, and others espousing support for Palestinian human rights, seeking to enter the country precludes their participation." In fact, in 2019, Rashida was denied entry into Palestine by the Israeli government because of her support of Palestinian rights―denying Rashida the right to visit her sity (grandmother), for what would likely have been the last time. Today marks an important day for Rashida’s re-election campaign. Tonight at midnight we’ll close the books on a critical fundraising deadline ―reporting on how much our campaign has raised and spent, and how much cash-on-hand we have available to take on the Super PACs and special interests who want to maintain the unjust status quo. | Last year, an AIPAC-aligned Super PAC spent more than $1 million in mailers and TV and digital ads in an attempt to defeat Rashida and attack her record of fighting for her district. Rashida regularly drafts legislation in partnership with her residents. Just this month, Rashida re-introduced her Prohibit Auto Insurance Discrimination Act (PAID Act) , to stop insurance companies from using non-driving factors when determining insurance rates and eligibility. Checks and balances are necessary to preserve our democracy

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65715838/414330263/966991095?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMzhlMTZiYS03ZTE3LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=y-p7P7tOqG98KevQhEfQtDLdEXAbg0-olwHuDGuB6n8=&emci=8fd25694-6517-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=a38e16ba-7e17-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=43402272) | I'm furious, Peter: **Today, the Supreme Court undermined our nation’s commitment to racial justice, LGBTQ+ equality, and student debt relief. ** All three of the Supreme Court Justices appointed by twice-impeached-now-indicted former President Donald Trump voted to end affirmative action in higher education, voted to allow businesses to discriminate against LGBTQ+ customers, and voted to block President Biden’s plan to cancel up to $20,000 in student debt relief for millions of Americans. When _Roe_ was overturned last summer, I stated unequivocally that the Supreme Court had lost its legitimacy. And today, it’s clear that the Supreme Court is more out-of-touch than ever before – ruling without regard for the will of the vast majority of Americans who believe in racial equity, support equal rights for their LGBTQ+ friends and neighbors, and want help dealing with the ballooning student debt crisis. I will be honest with you: The future of our democracy under this Supreme Court is frightening. I am outraged, but I am determined. With the Court’s willingness to overturn precedent, the time for checks and balances is long overdue: **We must expand the Supreme Court, enact term limits, and make this branch of government more reflective of the will of the people.** If we do not act, the future of our essential rights – particularly when it comes to racial equity and LGBTQ+ rights – will be in jeopardy. Ultimately, the people will decide the contours of our rights and freedoms – not a man or woman behind a bench. I will continue to fight in Congress to ensure the voices of the people are heard. name: Shamaine Daniels
subject: "What a difference five years makes"
body:
www.danielsforcongress.org [www.danielsforcongress.org]
>From my opponent and his Freedom Caucus flunkies, to idealogues on the Supreme Court the extremists are rolling back decades of progress for our country. We have to stand up TOGETHER!
Friend
"What a difference five years makes." That is how Justice Sonya Sotomayor began her dissent in today's landmark Supreme Court decision which chips away at anti-discrimination protections for members of the LGBTQ+ community.
That decision came right on the heels of yesterday's ruling that colleges and universities could no longer consider race when it comes to admission decisions. And all of this comes just a year after the Supreme Court took away a woman's right to make her own healthcare and reproductive decisions by overturning Roe v. Wade.
It feels like decades of social progress are being rolled back right in front of our eyes because that is exactly what is happening. The question is, what are we going to do about it?
If you're ready to help lend your voice to the battle for our rights, please consider making a contribution before our end of quarter deadline TONIGHT. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Let me assure you, this fight isn't over. There are many battles ahead. What is still to come is anyone's guess. With the conservative majority on the Supreme Court my opponent, Scott Perry, and his extremist allies in the Freedom Caucus are only going to become more emboldened.
What rights could be at risk? We don't want to find out, and we don't have to.
We can stop Scott Perry, Marjorie Taylor Green, Lauren Boebert and the rest of them at the ballot box. That is why I am asking you to chip-in TODAY. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Five years from now we can all be sitting back and saying "what a difference five years makes" because we stood up and elected leaders, like me, who want to expand more rights and freedoms to all Americans OR we can be remembering days like today as the good old days.
The choice is yours. If you choose to stand-up and fight, then PLEASE make a contribution before tonight's deadline. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Together, we'll take our rights back!
With Gratitude,
Shamaine

name: Eugene DePasquale
subject: what the Supreme Court just did
disclaimer_text: Paid for by DePasquale for Attorney General
body:
Team, this has been a dispiriting week for all Americans. And for many of us, these last 48 hours have been particularly difficult.

This week, the Supreme Court rejected affirmative action at colleges, struck down the Biden administration’s student loan forgiveness plan, and gave businesses the green light to turn away LGBTQ+ customers.

I know many of our family, friends, and colleagues are feeling unsafe and unsupported. I too am disappointed, angry, and fed up.

I’m writing to tell you that as your next Attorney General, I will fight like hell every single day to make sure these injustices are addressed and every Pennsylvanian’s rights and freedoms are protected. Here in Pennsylvania, choosing the next Attorney General is one of the most important ways we can right these wrongs.

This is not the last word on the right to choose, equal opportunity in higher education, or equal protection under the law. Now more than ever, we can't give up on these fights.

We can scream. We can cry. But then we need to pick ourselves back up. We have to channel our anger. We have to double our resolve.

You ready for this fight, team? I know I am.

These will be some of the toughest battles we will ever have to face. It won’t be easy, but I’m determined to defend your rights. I refuse to back down.

The Supreme Court may have stood against you – but I promise I won’t. As Attorney General, I will have the back of the LGBTQ+ community. I will fight for reproductive freedom. I’ll continue the fight for racial justice. Hell, I’ll take these fights back to the Supreme Court if I have to.

So while today might be hard for us, I’m hoping you can take a moment to look towards the future. To acknowledge that we have the power to fight for the change we want.

We can make that change here in Pennsylvania. But I can’t do it alone. I’m gonna need your help.

Stay strong,

Eugene

clean_body: Team, this has been a dispiriting week for all Americans. And for many of us, these last 48 hours have been particularly difficult. This week, the Supreme Court rejected affirmative action at colleges, struck down the Biden administration’s student loan forgiveness plan, and gave businesses the green light to turn away LGBTQ+ customers. I know many of our family, friends, and colleagues are feeling unsafe and unsupported. I too am disappointed, angry, and fed up. I’m writing to tell you that as your next Attorney General, I will fight like hell every single day to make sure these injustices are addressed and every Pennsylvanian’s rights and freedoms are protected. Here in Pennsylvania, choosing the next Attorney General is one of the most important ways we can right these wrongs. This is not the last word on the right to choose, equal opportunity in higher education, or equal protection under the law. Now more than ever, we can't give up on these fights. We can scream. We can cry. But then we need to pick ourselves back up. We have to channel our anger. We have to double our resolve. You ready for this fight, team? I know I am. These will be some of the toughest battles we will ever have to face. It won’t be easy, but I’m determined to defend your rights. I refuse to back down. The Supreme Court may have stood against you – but I promise I won’t. As Attorney General, I will have the back of the LGBTQ+ community. I will fight for reproductive freedom. I’ll continue the fight for racial justice. Hell, I’ll take these fights back to the Supreme Court if I have to. So while today might be hard for us, I’m hoping you can take a moment to look towards the future. To acknowledge that we have the power to fight for the change we want. body:
Dear Peter,
Despite our best efforts, we are still about $63,000 short of our fundraising goal for the quarter, and **today is the last day of the quarter.**
We've been sending mail, emails, calling, making phone calls, and holding events --- everything we can to raise the money we desperately need to defeat the most vulnerable Democrat in Congress, Marie Perez.
And as I finish making calls and doing events for the quarter this evening, we're still way short of our goal.
Please - if you can spare anything today, send it in at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/donatenow](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/W7CAjHiJmjJPDD4pXCjulw/EfUavUO2a4w892la1qWgEZWw).
However, I also have some good news. One of nation's top polling firms did an independent survey of my district and found that a super-majority of Republicans -- 81% -- support my campaign for the Republican nomination.
Republicans here know **I lost by less than 1%** in the last election despite a divisive primary and being outspent by Democrat Marie Perez by 6-to-1, and they're rallying early and eagerly to my campaign.
We can win this, but only if we get the help we need.
Here and now, on the last day of the quarter, will you help top us off so we can close our $63,000 gap at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/donatenow](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/W7CAjHiJmjJPDD4pXCjulw/EfUavUO2a4w892la1qWgEZWw)?
This seat is ours for the taking - please, join us in this mission today.
Respectfully,

body:
We’re working hard to ensure we have all the tools necessary to elect gun violence prevention champions in 2024.

| Peter,

I wanted to make sure you saw our message from earlier today. We’re just hours away from our public fundraising deadline and need your help to cross the finish line.

Welcome to the Indiana Democratic Party’s weekly newsletter, The Kernel of Truth. This is just the latest in a line of sad days for the rights of Hoosier women. Republicans will own the consequences from this ban, as women will be denied care or have to travel far distances to other states to receive care. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65719011/414342271/1038529010?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMTM2YzZiZS04NDE3LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vhHxhSSdWGXZ73u8fsVgpjmc_9t8jaeiQ1s8px2HXCE=&emci=93e469d1-6717-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=e136c6be-8417-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=4925535) [Share INDems](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65719012/414342272/-881011206?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMTM2YzZiZS04NDE3LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vhHxhSSdWGXZ73u8fsVgpjmc_9t8jaeiQ1s8px2HXCE=&emci=93e469d1-6717-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=e136c6be-8417-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=4925535) We will continue fighting because every Hoosier deserves fundamental reproductive rights. subject: Here’s how I found out I lost in 2022.

body:
We came closer than anyone expected in 2022 to flipping this seat.

| Peter,

After the polls closed in my 2022 campaign against Ken Calvert, we were feeling pretty excited about our chances. The first few batches of votes released by the registrar showed us with a promising lead, and while the race hadn’t been called, things were good enough to get an invitation to attend new member orientation in Washington.
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/65719275/414343054/395234972?refcode=BLU-FFP-20230630-1-EM&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImJhMDE1ZWUwLTg0MTctZWUxMS1hOWJiLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=SioGdNGZCIy0Sd13vmQbZRBgP2vXqa22LiomITcGME4=)
_Day one of new member orientation last Fall. Credit: POLITICO._ It was awe-inspiring being inside the Capitol as a prospective member and learning about the job I’d spent a year running for and hoped to have. I also enjoyed getting to know some (we had hoped) soon-to-be colleagues.

**Then, literally as I was standing on the House floor, I got the alert on my phone; a new batch of votes finally put Ken Calvert’s vote share out of reach. The Associated Press called the race, and I officially lost.**

So my partner Paolo and I did what a lot of couples might do: we went to the hotel bar.

As we were sitting there, news broke on TV that Donald Trump had just announced his campaign for president.

And I knew in that moment that our fight wasn’t over yet — that our democracy remains fragile, and it’s on each of us to do what’s in our power to better our communities and our country.

Peter, running for Congress a second time was not a decision I came to lightly, but I'm back in it because I know exactly what is at stake. It’s not the time to give up, and I’ve been so humbled that so many across Riverside County who supported our campaign in 2022 haven’t given up either.

**We came closer than anyone expected in 2022 to flipping this seat, and I wouldn’t be in this if I wasn’t confident we could win. But I can’t do this alone:**

But Pennsylvania is always a battleground, and we need to do everything we can to keep moving forward. I need your continued support to keep up the fight here in Pennsylvania, and why your donation today is so important.**

So Derek, can you chip in today to help Team Shapiro keep charging forward? Any amount makes a difference.

body:
#
Peter,
It’s Summer Lee here — Congresswoman for PA-12 and proud Justice Democrat.
Did you know that Justice Democrats recruited me to run for Congress and supported my campaign from Day #1? They stood by my side when we faced millions of dollars in opposition spending from groups like AIPAC.
Now, I’m asking you directly, Peter: [**Will you split a $3 contribution right now between Justice Democrats and my campaign to help us both reach our critical end-of-quarter fundraising goals?**](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/135483?refcode=em20230630-29678&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=29678%2E1203867%2E2I35Xa)
**[Contribute $3](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/135483?refcode=em20230630-29678&t=20&akid=29678%2E1203867%2E2I35Xa)**
Justice Democrats is working every single day to transform the Democratic Party to actually work for the people of this country and not corporations and big donors — and every single grassroots contribution helps to power their work.
We are in a fight for the soul of the Democratic Party and the other side has millions of dollars at their disposal and money from corporate PACs.
We have people like you who are willing to contribute what they can afford because they believe in the issues we’re fighting for. When hundreds of people step up and chip in $5, $20, or even $50 it really adds up.
[**Please split a $3 contribution between Justice Democrats and my campaign before midnight to help ensure we both have the resources to sustain our work.**](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/135483?refcode=em20230630-29678&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=29678%2E1203867%2E2I35Xa)
Solidarity forever,
Summer Lee
Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank [here.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=22&akid=29678%2E1203867%2E2I35Xa) We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong. The use of race as a factor in [college admissions](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=312751df5c404fb288527318a0ace705&_e=qSgbbNao6MxDxsWq-wfFL6cb_CQDGUkBwiIwT7XKuXJ_ZJ5Wx3sXT3NUOeS_QduJ6_i2Q4Ln6BfkA6pZaSPCUILN1HqlsfjvfkAblGXTwcvGqm41yVv_l18qBZhV4RE9NiO0SCltoChjgELwr-fs0J3DjSQGdOsIgy6A2ie8BCOb65odgrJi0hvUdnpOPo3PyKCHKc2wSWzuuBSylV1UFe003jA_2SrR95dkK7WPCFoH5uFsRJyEQPDRtzX0JrHorPagq-V7UQHRwZVuW-GGQPx7uoW_h5G8llTjVaCILPU1eyDff6f_3G21eIkZglC7Ngsf5EV4P0ens5KDyfLTPA%3D%3D) undermines the bedrock on which higher education prides itself on—hard work and determination. | Peter,
_Did you catch my last message?_

The FEC Deadline is **MIDNIGHT TONIGHT** , and I have been concerned that we won’t reach our goal. Peter, that’s why I am coming to you personally with an important message.
[**I WILL PERSONALLY MATCH DOLLAR FOR DOLLAR WHAT YOU DONATE BEFORE MIDNIGHT.**](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=b83c32541f&e=273c9a71fb)
A contribution of any amount, big or small, will make the biggest difference in the outcome of Election Day. In order to win this fight against the radical Left in Nevada and DC, I need all hands on deck. [**_Please, CHIP IN to my fight:_**](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=853a800ffe&e=273c9a71fb)

| Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

| Peter,

I just had a rather important meeting with my team. Sadly, I am behind on my End of Quarter goal! This is quite a setback

Growing up, I was taught that it's not polite to ask for money. However, when it comes to running for Congress, unfortunately, it’s necessary.

For years now, the Democrats have had a major advantage against us. We are outnumbered in Nevada and facing a serious uphill battle. Starting Quarter 3 off behind goal is only going to make things harder for us.

Our country is desperately in need of new leadership, principled in patriotism and conservatism. I know you know how important this fight is.

Patrick

body:
Today's Supreme Court decision is an outrage, and I am disappointed at the highest level.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=315%2E791427%2EU2JHIo)

43 million Americans.
With today's decision, that is how many people the right-wing partisan justices on the Supreme Court have condemned to years — sometimes a lifetime — of crushing debt. All thanks to their own corruption.
With a single move, this illegitimate court has transferred $1.6 trillion back onto the shoulders of the working class.
Millions of people across the country who had hopes and aspirations of starting families, buying homes, opening businesses, or simply having a shred of economic security restored to their lives have had the rug pulled out from under them.
It is an outrage, and I'm disappointed at the highest level.
As President Biden said yesterday following the court’s ruling on affirmative action — we cannot let this decision be the last word.
**Every last option needs to be on the table to deliver relief and fix this broken court.**
That means using the Higher Education Act.
It means enacting Supreme Court term limits.
Passing mandatory ethics rules.
Limiting judicial review.
And yes — expanding the court.
We cannot return to the status quo of mass default and distress. Poll after poll after poll shows that the American people support debt relief for the working and middle class, and believe we should not continue burdening generations of people to a lifetime of crushing debt.
We know that the president has the authority to do this, and that the illegitimate, right-wing majority on the Supreme Court have massively overstepped.
Today's decision cannot be the end of the discussion. This was a promise made to millions of Americans, and we must carry it out. That's why I'm asking:
**[Add your name to my petition: Every possible option must be on the table to deliver student debt relief and fix the broken and illegitimate Supreme Court.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/io-em-june23-su-student-debt/?source=em230630-2-t1&refcode2=315.791427.U2JHIo&t=2&akid=315%2E791427%2EU2JHIo)**

Debt-forgiveness is a moral necessity, and an investment in our students, our people, our economy, our present and our future. Let's get it done.
Thanks for adding your name today.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

Fellow conservative, Bernie needs your help if he's going flip Ohio and help Republicans take back the Senate. When he was five years old, Bernie's family came to the United States from Colombia. His family believed in the American Dream and they bet it all to start a new life. From there, he grew up to become a successful executive in the auto industry and has created thousands of jobs in Ohio. Now, Bernie is running to lead the fight for freedom and take on the far left and political insiders that have sent our nation down the wrong path. He has the qualifications and the experience to be an effective United States Senator right away. He recognizes that the things that make our country great are under assault by Joe Biden, Chuck Schumer and Sherrod Brown. Bernie is the candidate Ohio needs to fight for the American freedoms that brought his family here. He knows first-hand how great the America Dream is and will fight to make sure we don't lose it. Ohio’s Democrat Senator and career Washington insider Sherrod Brown is vulnerable, and one of Republicans' top targets to defeat in 2024. This is one of our best opportunities to take back the Senate majority, and I believe Bernie can get the job done. Thank you, Ambassador Richard Grenell Meet Bernie Moreno: | Bernie Moreno fights for the American dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18. Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America. In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board. After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation. Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First. Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has. I joined the Army at 17 to afford college, friend. **While I am proud of my service to our country, I will _never_ believe that you should have to get shot at in order to afford the cost of schooling.** Today, right-wing justices on the Supreme Court ruled against student debt relief for millions of Americans, including 96,200 folks right here in PA-01. As a result, the barriers to higher education just grew significantly higher for kids who grew up in low-income or working-class families like mine. Adding to the horror today, **they also gave businesses a license to discriminate against LGBTQ+ customers.** These rulings will undoubtedly make life harder for working-class students, students of color, and LGBTQ+ communities across the country. Let's be clear: The Supreme Court is wildly out of touch with the vast majority of Americans. The best way to fight back is to elect people who actually represent our shared values. **Will you make a donation before midnight to help us reach our goal and ensure we have the resources to win in November? >>** **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/beshear-june-23?refcode2=personal](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65725399/414358820/907170691?refcode=em23_230630_eoq8_fnd_gq_act___eh_ettx&utm_campaign=em23_230630_eoq8_fnd_gq_act___eh_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=f97f4471-9117-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzM0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmOTdmNDQ3MS05MTE3LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pB18YyfUyC80a-6e9-EQ7MmQxY50oKys9PbL_5tU5Ss=)**

I know this message is long, but I hope you'll take a moment to read it and be reminded of all the things we have been able to accomplish because of our victory in 2020. Then, I'll explain why your support matters so much — especially this early in a campaign. When Kamala and I were sworn in over two years ago, the economy was on its back. Schools and businesses were closed. People were hurting. And far too many were mourning the loss of a loved one to COVID-19.

Kamala and I agreed that we couldn't just rebuild the economy as it was before: we needed to build an economy from the bottom up and the middle out, not the top down. So we got right to work and passed the American Rescue Plan.

**Today, our economy has recovered faster and stronger than any other developed country in the world, we've created more jobs in two years than any president in a four-year term, and the unemployment rate is near record lows.**

And we didn't stop there: we kept working to make progress on the issues that matter.

We passed the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law, kicking off a decade of rebuilding our country's roads, bridges, highways, ports, internet and railroads.

We passed the most significant gun safety legislation in nearly three decades.

We took on Big Pharma _and won_ , capping the cost of insulin at $35 a month for seniors — now, the biggest insulin manufacturers are lowering the cost for everyone.

We passed the Inflation Reduction Act, which is bringing down costs for working people and is the largest investment to combat climate change in U.S. history — because I believe building a clean energy future starts in America.

When I look back at all the things we've accomplished together, and all the work EMILYs List has done to elect Democratic pro-choice women, I feel proud — _and I'm reminded that there's so much more work for us to get done_. **If you're with Kamala and me in this fight, can I ask you to split a donation between our campaign and EMILYs List to help us build the foundation we'll need to win in 2024 and elect Democratic pro-choice women up and down the ballot?** | | | |

clean_body: | | | I'm writing today to remind you of all the things we've accomplished because we won in 2020. = Peter, I'll get right to it: = I know this message is long, but I hope you'll take a moment to read it and be reminded of all the things we have been able to accomplish because of our victory in 2020. Then, I'll explain why your support matters so much — especially this early in a campaign. When Kamala and I were sworn in over two years ago, the economy was on its back. Schools and businesses were closed. People were hurting. And far too many were mourning the loss of a loved one to COVID-19. Kamala and I agreed that we couldn't just rebuild the economy as it was before: we needed to build an economy from the bottom up and the middle out, not the top down. So we got right to work and passed the American Rescue Plan. Today, our economy has recovered faster and stronger than any other developed country in the world, we've created more jobs in two years than any president in a four-year term, and the unemployment rate is near record lows. And we didn't stop there: we kept working to make progress on the issues that matter. We passed the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law, kicking off a decade of rebuilding our country's roads, bridges, highways, ports, internet and railroads. We passed the most significant gun safety legislation in nearly three decades. We took on Big Pharma and won , capping the cost of insulin at $35 a month for seniors — now, the biggest insulin manufacturers are lowering the cost for everyone. We passed the Inflation Reduction Act, which is bringing down costs for working people and is the largest investment to combat climate change in U.S. history — because I believe building a clean energy future starts in America. When I look back at all the things we've accomplished together, and all the work EMILYs List has done to elect Democratic pro-choice women, I feel proud — and I'm reminded that there's so much more work for us to get done. If you're with Kamala and me in this fight, can I ask you to split a donation between our campaign and EMILYs List to help us build the foundation we'll need to win in 2024 and elect Democratic pro-choice women up and down the ballot? | | | | If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately and be split between Biden for President and EMILYs List: | | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = | | I know I don't need to remind you what's at stake in this election: the MAGA Republicans in this race want to drag us backward. When they look at America, all they can see is carnage, darkness and despair. They spread fear and lies for profit and power. When Kamala and I look at America, we see possibility. If the last two years show you anything, it's that there's not a single thing beyond our capacity if we do it together. I am proud to have you in my corner.
