subject: I know our people-powered team is unbeatable.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Deluzio for Congress
body:
Hi Derek,

I know you’ve heard from my team a lot this week, and I appreciate you sticking with us. This is a big night for our campaign, and I’d like to take a moment to explain why just one more time.

After tonight, my team will turn over our fundraising report to the Federal Election Commission, and then everyone – including Kevin McCarthy and the right-wing Republicans targeting western Pennsylvania – will be able to see the strength of our grassroots movement. I know our people-powered team is unbeatable, and that’s why it’s so important to me that we put forward a report that reflects our strength.

Derek, asking for money is probably my least favorite part of campaigning. But the truth is, we don’t have the same corporate donors that the other side has. I’m proud to be funded by folks like you, but that means hitting critical goals like this one is dependent on all of us working together.

Derek, we only need to raise $982 more to hit our goal and end June on a strong note. If you’re able to chip in to help us close the gap, here’s a link just for you:

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/del-email-june2023?refcode=em_fr_2023.06.30_b2_cp_all&amount=15

Thanks again for sticking with us. I appreciate your support.

Chris

body:
Hi team,

I was about to write an update about today being our last day before our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline... and then the SCOTUS rulings happened. **I won’t sugarcoat it: I am just as pissed off as you are.[Help us fight back against the Supreme Court and rush a donation of $5 now >>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65727203/414362714/-1104872842?refcode=em23_230630_EOQ5_fndd_gq_act___SS_ettx&utm_campaign=em23_230630_EOQ5_fndd_gq_act___SS_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=6b4e203f-9417-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM5MjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNmI0ZTIwM2YtOTQxNy1lZTExLWE5YmItMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=bKEGQjdC-AtIP1l8NDu_dfroh3XssGQfXSLk2JR2F0Y=)**

name: Dr. Shawn Wilson for Governor
subject: Ending June on a strong note
body:
image of ... [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/swlogo2.png]
TEAM WILSON WEEKLY UPDATES
Peter,
With actions in Washington including the announcement of landmark investments in high-speed Internet for rural America [https://www.nola.com/news/politics/louisiana-to-get-13b-for-high-speed-internet-biden-says/article_1123622a-146d-11ee-9412-7b99cd734b84.html] and the Supreme Court decision to have arguments heard to create a second majority-minority district [https://www.wdsu.com/article/louisiana-redistricting-map-supreme-court/44343741] in Louisiana, as well as the Louisiana State University baseball team winning the Men’s College World Series [https://www.brproud.com/sports/college-sports/lsu/lsu-baseball-wins-another-national-championship-beating-gators-18-4/] , it has been a newsworthy week for national impact on Louisiana.
Back at home, our campaign has made some major waves, too, securing the Louisiana Democratic Party ’s endorsement. We’ve been up and down and all around the state and I was grateful to make multiple stops in North Louisiana this week.
ANNOUNCING MY POLICY PLANS FOR LOUISIANA
This week, I was so proud to announce my plans as the next Governor of our beautiful state. While some of my opponents fight amongst themselves and refuse to debate, I am rolling up my sleeves to fight for the hard working people of Louisiana.
My platform presents solutions to issues that impact all of us, with no one left behind. I know that by continuing to listen to your needs, and collaborating with stakeholders, we can raise the quality of life in every Parish - rural and urban areas alike.
It’s our time, Louisiana.
The plans are available at WilsonForLA.com/issues [WilsonForLA.com/issues]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/Shawn%20Wilson%20%20Solutions%20Social%20%281%29.png]
HIGHLIGHTS FROM THE CAMPAIGN TRAIL
New Orleans
Saturday night, I had the opportunity to share my vision for Louisiana at the NAACP New Orleans Freedom Fund Banquet , hosted at Xavier University of Louisiana .
Voter education, empowerment, and protection is the backbone of a functioning democracy. I applaud the branch’s work in the community advocating for a more just democracy.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/My%20project-1%20-%202023-06-30T085204.347.png]
Giving Praise
Rocki and I were honored to celebrate Pastor Moses Gordon II 's 47th Pastoral Anniversary at Fellowship Missionary Baptist Church in New Orleans on Sunday. Longevity like that shows a dedication to ministry that inspires, comforts, and protects. I was also glad to run into my friend Bro. Joseph Byrd , the former Dean of Students at Xavier University of Louisiana .
After leaving the 2nd service of the day at Pilgrim Baptist Church in Kenner with Rev. Mitchell Stevens , we visited St. Thomas Missionary Baptist Church under the pastorship of Rev. Travis George . Thank you to Dr. C.S. Gordon for your blessed word.
The fourth church was special. Evening Star Missionary Baptist Church is my “Big Mama’s” church on Grefer Ln. where my dad grew up. My dad’s momma would bring us here often, so I have many fond memories. Pastor Keith Paul Stewman knows all of my family that have worshiped there. It’s a small world y’all!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/My%20project-1%20-%202023-06-30T090736.534.png]
Lafayette
Rocki and I were honored to be invited to bring greetings for the Memorial Service at the 101st Annual Grand Session of the Most Worshipful Universal Grand Lodge A.F. & A.M. & Star of Hope Grand Chapter O.E.S of the State of Louisiana .
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/My%20project-1%20-%202023-06-30T085439.165.png]
State Troopers Forum
Thank you to the Louisiana State Troopers Association for hosting a Gubernatorial Forum . It was a pleasure to spend time with active & retired troopers and their families. I run into people I know everywhere! Several troopers went to college with me and served as University Police Officers along with the future First Lady .
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/My%20project-1%20-%202023-06-30T091856.765.png]
Sibley
In Sibley, I had a chance to visit with ministers and grassroots leaders who share my vision of engaging faith-based organizations to strengthen communities. Thank you for the North LA hospitality.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/My%20project-1%20-%202023-06-30T081604.949.png]
Monroe
We had a wonderful event in Monroe hosted by Councilmember Rodney Welch , Robert & Pauline Clark , Mayor Dave Norris , Dr. Richard Smith and Dr. Jarmon Comeaux .
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/My%20project-1%20-%202023-06-30T082153.199.png]
West Monroe
While passing through North Louisiana, I couldn’t help but stop in West Monroe for an award-winning Chili Dog at Coney Island Connection .
As Governor, I will work hard every day to attract new business and grow what is already here.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/My%20project-1%20-%202023-06-30T082617.972.png]
VP Harris
I was honored to attend Vice President Kamala Harris ' speech to help kick off the 2023 Essence Festival of Culture , where I was able to connect with Congressman Troy Carter and longtime Urban League President Marc Morial .
After the VP’s event, we went to the Congressional Black Caucus Next Gen reception at the New Orleans Jazz Market , where I was grateful to speak with some bright young minds, the leaders of tomorrow.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104399/images/My%20project-1%20-%202023-06-30T085923.148.png]
ENDORSEMENTS
LOUISIANA DEMOCRATIC PARTY
I am proud to announce that the Louisiana Democratic Party has unanimously endorsed my candidacy for Governor. I am excited to add their support to a growing coalition intent on bettering Louisiana. With a united party backing a single candidate prior to qualifying for the race, we can take this momentum and turn it into a groundswell of support.
Together we have the numbers to take us to a first place finish on October 14th, a victory for people in every parish. Now that we’re all together, we can begin to address real, everyday issues like public safety, expanding economic opportunity, strengthening education, improving healthcare accessibility and equitability, addressing the affordable housing crisis, and so much more.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

An "insect apocalypse."
A "second Silent Spring."
A "catastrophic collapse of nature's ecosystems."
This is how scientists are describing the loss of bees and other insects. [**The time to act is now: Donate $27 or more and help us meet our $150,000 Fiscal Year End goal for pollinators and the planet! When you do, your gift will be matched, dollar for dollar, up to our goal -- but only until midnight TONIGHT.**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1857183?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
Neonicotinoid pesticides are a key driver of this crisis. They can impact bees' ability to navigate and reproduce and**even kill bees on contact.** But they're also the most widely used insecticides in agriculture.
The EPA has a chance to ban neonics once and for all. Instead, it might _**approve these pesticides for another 15 years.**_ But there's still hope, Friend. Because of supporters like you, we have the chance to make real change -- change that would help protect bees, people, and the planet. Will you join us in this fight?
**Help get bee-killing pesticides out of our food system and protect our planet. Donate $27 immediately and help us reach our $150,000 goal before midnight TONIGHT!**

---
Bees play a crucial role in their ecosystems. From fields of blooming wildflowers to rows of veggies on farms, these insects and others aid in plant reproduction. Many of these plants support an entire web of life by offering habitat and food for countless other species.
We rely on bees and other pollinators for 75% of the world's food crops, including the most nutritious -- so when we lose bees, we also lose some of the foods **that keep us healthy!** In fact, the decline in bees and other pollinators has already harmed global fruit, vegetable, and nut production. Without access to these vital crops and a healthy diet, people could be at higher risk of _**heart disease, stroke, diabetes, and even cancer, according to a recent study.**_
There's no mystery here. Study after study has found that the massive use of pesticides, like Bayer-Monsanto's bee-toxic neonicotinoids, is a key driver in the decimation of pollinators.
But pollinator-killers like Bayer-Monsanto are sweeping their lethal impact under the rug -- and the United States EPA is giving them a free pass, allowing widespread use of toxic pesticides instead of shifting away from chemicals we KNOW are killing massive numbers of bees.
[](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1857184?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
**Stop the downward spiral of vulnerable pollinator populations. Donate $27 or more to Friends of the Earth today!**

Bees are a canary in the coal mine, signaling that the toxic way we produce food is on a deadly track. We must act NOW to protect our health and ensure that we are not among the last generations to share the planet with countless species of wild bees.
At Friends of the Earth, we are doing everything we can to help save pollinators, protect our health, and stop the destruction of our planet. We're working to pass laws that ban toxic pesticides that are driving the decline of bees and butterflies. At the same time, we're pushing major grocery companies like Kroger to stop selling food grown with these chemicals. With your help and membership support today, we can win for precious pollinators and our planet.
But the bees are running out of time -- and they need you.
If we don't stand up to Big Ag now, **we could stand to lose _hundreds_ of wild bee species in North America alone.** It's up to you to help prevent a world without these vulnerable pollinators. Please, Friend, we need you by our side as we ramp up our efforts to save wild bees from extinction and protect our planet.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

clean_body: | | | | | ---|---|--- | | | Time is against us, friend. To ward off the extinction crisis facing vital species and avoid massive destruction of essential ecosystems, we MUST ramp up our fight against the Big Polluters harming our planet for profits. But right now, we’re up against one of our biggest deadlines of the year, and we’re falling dangerously short of our goal. == Worse, in the last few hours, donations have been slowing down. At this rate, we won’t hit our $150,000 goal in time to make the most of our rare match! That means scaling back our planet-saving work while greedy corporations EXPAND their mega-polluting plans. We can’t let that happen. We’re worried our emails got buried in your inbox, and that’s why you haven’t taken advantage of our rare End of Fiscal Year match. This opportunity expires at midnight TONIGHT. So, we had to reach out and make sure you got the chance to DOUBLE YOUR IMPACT for our planet now while there’s still time to make a difference. == If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | == | | == | | == | | == The situation for our planet is dire, friend, and we can't allow it to get any worse. Corporate mega-polluters are largely to blame, and we MUST hold them accountable for the damage they’ve caused. Chemical corporations continue to produce MILLIONS of pounds of unnecessary pesticides per year despite their toxic impact on our precious bees and the future of our food system. Meanwhile, mining, logging and drilling companies are teaming up with ruthless trophy hunters to lobby against legal protections for endangered wildlife – like iconic gray wolves and grizzly bears – all in an effort to swoop in and exploit our public lands for more profits. And across our fragile oceans, Big Oil and industrial shipping projects are threatening the survival of essential marine life, like the last Southern Resident orcas on Earth, while spewing more fossil fuel pollution that puts all our futures at risk. We're fighting back, friend. Friends of the Earth won't let Big Polluters continue to exploit our planet for short-term profit. But we're running out of time to stop these corporate-driven catastrophes before it's too late. body:
Hi there,

I’ll cut right to the chase – we’re still running about $2,000 short of where we need to be ahead of tonight’s FEC deadline, so I’m reaching out one last time for your help to close the gap before 9 pm. Can I count on you to chip in $3 before your Friday night plans commence to get us there?

Peter,

I’m glad I could catch you before we break for the weekend. I know I’ve been in touch quite a bit this week, so I’ll get right to the point:

Tonight at midnight is a critical quarterly fundraising deadline for our campaign. We’ll be submitting our fundraising numbers to the FEC and showing my anti-choice opponent, Rep. Mike Garcia, what our campaign is made of.

At the moment, we’re about $3,210 short of our $50,000 goal. That means with just a few more grassroots contributions, we’ll be able to show real strength on this report!

Will you contribute before midnight to help us reach our goal just in time? Your donation could be the one that puts us over the top. Here’s a good link: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gw-q2-2023**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65732092/414375109/1224595648?refcode=em-6.30.23-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyM2JkM2U5OS1hMDE3LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EGyEDwTP9v-ELo0siKcu7LoHWQyLK6ETKaKkeN2oybo=)

The good news is that we’re building incredible momentum in our campaign to unseat Garcia, and we need to keep it going. Tonight's fundraising deadline will be a key moment in signaling our strength.

So I’ll ask one last time: will you chip in whatever you can before midnight to help us send Mike Garcia a message? Here’s the link again: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gw-q2-2023**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65732093/414375110/1224595648?refcode=em-6.30.23-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyM2JkM2U5OS1hMDE3LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EGyEDwTP9v-ELo0siKcu7LoHWQyLK6ETKaKkeN2oybo=)

I appreciate your support, Peter.

Best,

George
